title: 第五章　种族的世界

zh: 请容我重申密尔的那句箴言：对“野蛮人”不可能有自由。把这个刺耳的词替换为“政治上与智识上不成熟的人”，然后思考这样一个命题：对这类人来说，完全的民主未必是最适宜的政体；比如说，不受限制地投票和选举治国者的权利，可能导致许多其他自由的毁灭，也会断送经济实现发展的任何真正机会。
en: Let me recall Mill’s dictum that there can be no liberty for “savages.” Replace this harsh word by “politically and intellectually immature people” and reflect on the proposition that full democracy may not be the most suitable system of government for such people; that, for example, the unlimited right to vote and elect the men who will govern the country may lead to the destruction of many other freedoms and also of any real chance for economic development.

zh: ——弗里茨·马赫卢普，1969年
en: —Fritz Machlup, 1969

zh: 1945年之后，新自由主义者主张，帝国可以终结，但前提是资本的权利得到保障，民族国家不得阻碍货币与商品的自由流动。可是在非殖民化（decolonization）时代，当解放、民族自决（self-determination）与主权被奉为国家地位的界定特征时，又靠什么来确保这样的结果呢？1957年，在瑞士圣莫里茨举行的一次朝圣山学社（Mont Pèlerin Society，简称MPS）会议上，英国经济学家、后来出任MPS主席的阿瑟·申菲尔德把这个悖论分成两点提了出来：第一，“自由派不必非得是民主派，但要他不是民主派却极其困难。”第二，“他不必承认从属民族有权选择把自己的治理搞糟，但要他不这么做也绝非易事。”
十年后，MPS成员弗里茨·马赫卢普在致戈特弗里德·哈伯勒的一封信中表达了类似的看法，他写道：“民主的代价相当高昂。它使人无法做应当做的事，却迫使人做不应做的事——至少从公共利益看是这样。”
en: Empires could end, neoliberals argued after 1945, but only if capital rights were secured and nation-states were kept from impeding the free flow of money and goods. But how to ensure this outcome in an era of decolonization when liberation, self-determination, and sovereignty were touted as the defining traits of statehood? At a Mont Pèlerin Society (MPS) meeting in Saint Moritz, Switzerland, in 1957, British economist and later MPS president Arthur Shenfield presented the paradox in two parts: First, “the liberal does not have to be a democrat but it is uncommonly difficult for him not to be.” Second, “he does not have to allow the claim of dependent peoples to choose to misrule themselves but it is by no means easy for him not to do so.”

MPS member Fritz Machlup made a similar point in a letter to Gottfried Haberler a decade later when he observed that “the cost of democracy is rather high. It makes it impossible to do what ought to be done and forces one to do what ought not to be done, in the public interest.”

zh: 在新自由主义者看来，大众民主与民族自决的原则令人苦恼。它们有用，且无法被轻易取消，但同时也潜藏着扰乱世界经济的可能。在战后年代，新自由主义的立场似乎正在落败。正如此前的哈布斯堡继承国一样，非洲与亚洲的新兴国家，连同拉丁美洲较早的发展中国家，都寻求建立自己的工业，并寻求保护，以抵御全球竞争。当时流行的经济理论助长了新兴国家的抱负。美国的学者与政策制定者沉浸在战后的乐观情绪之中，决心对抗共产主义的诱惑，他们建立起一套知识体系，为伊丽莎白·博格沃特所称的“全球新政”（a New Deal for the world）这一政治目标提供了正当性依据，其内容涵盖充分就业、跨国工会主义，以及为大企业和民主治理同时提供机会。
所谓现代化理论，为本国经济从农业生产迈向“起飞”（take-off）规划了一条路径——届时新技术将提高生产率，并提升整体生活水平。
经济学家们辩称，在发展上起步既晚，于国家经济并非障碍而是福音，发展中国家可以采用别处已经开发出来的技术，从而享受“落后的优势”（advantages of backwardness）。一位内布拉斯加州参议员道出了时代精神，他许下一句令人难忘的大愿：“要把上海抬上去，再抬上去，一直抬上去，直到它和堪萨斯城一模一样。”
en: To neoliberals, the principles of mass democracy and national self-determination were vexed. They were useful and could not be easily undone, but they also bore the potential for world economic disruption. In the postwar years the neoliberal position appeared to be losing. Like the Habsburg successor states before them, new countries in Africa and Asia, alongside older developing nations in Latin America, sought to build up their own industry and secure protection from global competition. The aspirations of new nations were aided by the prevailing economic theories. U.S. academics and policy makers, flush with postwar optimism and determined to counter the lure of communism, established an epistemology that sanctioned the political goal of what Elizabeth Borgwardt calls “a New Deal for the world,” complete with full employment, transnational unionism, and opportunities for both big business and democratic governance.

So-called modernization theory mapped out a path for national economies to move from agricultural production to “take-off,” when new technologies would increase productivity and raise the overall standard of living.

Coming late to development was not an obstacle but a boon, economists argued. Developing nations could enjoy the “advantages of backwardness” by adopting technologies already developed elsewhere. A Nebraskan senator reflected the zeitgeist in his memorable promise to “lift Shanghai up and up, ever up, until it is just like Kansas City.”

zh: 然而，现代化理论从来不像它有时看上去那样占据霸权地位。新自由主义的批评者自始至终都在盯着“面向世界的新政”这幅图景。MPS成员很早就对外国援助持怀疑态度，把后殖民时代快速工业化的梦想视为经济民族主义的最新变体。
哈耶克称工业化是通往发展的唯一道路是一种“天真的谬误”。
新自由主义者把布雷顿森林体系——学者们称之为“嵌入性自由主义”（embedded liberalism）——视为一条通往自我孤立、喂养民族自主幻觉的道路。

新自由主义对主流发展理论的批评，始于这样一种信念：把曾经是农业的地区（如前殖民地）工业化，同时对以工业为主的地区（如西欧）的农业加以保护，会扭曲国际分工，并使各国专门从事与其自然禀赋并不相宜的生产部门。一个真正自由的世界经济——资本与商品在其中自由交换——将带来地球资源最有效的利用。融入世界市场是一个教化过程。后殖民国家非但不被允许躲开竞争的推拉之力，反而必须接受世界经济力量的训练，以便对市场需求的指引作出正确的回应。帝国的消失，意味着路德维希·冯·米塞斯所谓“竞争的统治”（the reign of competition）重新发挥作用。
en: Yet modernization theory was never as hegemonic as it sometimes seems. Neoliberal critics stalked the vision of a New Deal for the world from the start. MPS members were early skeptics of foreign aid and saw postcolonial dreams of rapid industrialization as the latest variant of economic nationalism.
Hayek called it a “naïve fallacy” that industrialization was the only way to development.
Neoliberals saw the Bretton Woods system, which scholars have called embedded liberalism, as a path to isolation feeding delusions of national autonomy.

The neoliberal critique of mainstream development theories began with the conviction that the industrialization of formerly agricultural areas (like former colonies) and the protection of agriculture in primarily industrial areas (like Western Europe) distorted the international division of labor and led nations to specialize in branches of production for which their natural endowments were unsuited. A truly liberal world economy, in which capital and goods were exchanged freely, would result in the most efficient use of the earth’s resources. Integration into the world market was a pedagogical process. Far from being permitted to shelter themselves from the push and pull of competition, postcolonial nations must be trained by the forces of the world economy to respond correctly to the guidance of market demand. The vanishing of empire meant a renewed role for what Ludwig von Mises called the reign of competition.

zh: 前面几章所描述的新自由主义世界经济秩序反方案，在短期内几乎没有取得成功。人们舍弃了“去计划化”的乌托邦，转而选择由福利国家集中分担风险。战后的自由贸易体制例外丛生，资本管制则得到国际货币基金组织（IMF）的认可。普遍性的投资准则在国家主权的暗礁上搁浅。问题的一部分似乎在于，他们没有承认世界已经改变。哈耶克式的“异邦人权”（xenos rights）诉求，近乎19世纪的治外法权原则——即外国行为体豁免于国内法律。哈耶克本人在1953年提出，美国政府可以为在海外投资的美国投资者承保财产被征收或资金汇回受阻的风险。他说，接受投资的各国应当“允许美国金融机构在其境内不受阻碍地运营”。
可是，谁来强迫它们这样做？这样颐指气使的做法又凭什么会被接受？路德维希·冯·米塞斯早在1943年就指出了这个问题：“以为这类冲突可以由不偏不倚的法院通过仲裁加以解决，这是一种幻觉。法院只能依据法典的条文施行正义，而恰恰是这些规定与规则本身正处于争论之中。”
en: The neoliberal counterproposals for world economic order described in the previous chapters met with little success in the short term. Utopias of deplanning were rejected for the collective risk-pooling of the welfare state. Postwar regimes of free trade were riddled with exceptions, and capital controls were sanctioned by the International Monetary Fund (IMF). Universal investment codes ran aground on the rock of national sovereignty. Part of the problem seemed to be the failure to acknowledge that the world had changed. The Hayekian demand for xenos rights came close to the nineteenth-century principle of extraterritoriality— the immunity of foreign actors from domestic laws. Hayek himself suggested in 1953 that the U.S. government might insure American overseas investors against expropriation or the blocked repatriation of funds. Recipient nations, he said, should “allow American financial institutions to operate unhindered within their territory.”

But who would force them to do so and why would such high-handedness be accepted? Ludwig von Mises had pointed out the problem in 1943, saying, “It is an illusion to believe that such conflicts could be settled by arbitration on the part of impartial courts. A court can administer justice only according to the articles of a code. But it is exactly these prescriptions and rules which are contested.”

zh: 同样于1953年撰文的勒普克，也是外国援助最早的批评者之一；对帝国时代结束之后让治外法权死灰复燃的可行性，他同样不抱乐观。他写道，前殖民列强既无意愿也无实力恢复这样的权利。
一部投资准则固然有部分用处，能够创造出“公然违犯会很危险、绕开也会令人不安的规范”。但如果认为解决办法只是一个法律工程问题，那就表现了“法律迷信”（juridicism）、“虚假的国际主义”，以及——回响着1930年代经济外交的失败——一种妄想式的“会议崇拜”（conferencism）。
谁来就违规行为提起诉讼呢？是那个“西方政治智慧特意把它建成让欧洲的声音与发展中国家相比几乎听不见”的联合国吗？是海牙的国际刑事法院吗？他说，“仅仅提出这样的问题”，本身就体现了“最辛辣的讽刺”。
在勒普克看来，战后国际体系是一项有缺陷的工程。指望它为全球资本主义执行正当的行为准则，将是致命的。
en: Writing the same year, Röpke, an early critic of foreign aid, was also less than sanguine about the viability of reanimating extraterritoriality after the age of empire. Former colonial powers lacked both the will and the power to reinstate such rights, he wrote.

An investment code would be partially useful in creating “norms that would be dangerous to flout openly and uncomfortable to circumvent.” But to believe that a solution was merely a matter of legal engineering expressed “juridicism,” “false internationalism,” and, with echoes of the failures of economic diplomacy in the 1930s, a delusional “conferencism.”

Who would litigate infractions, Röpke wondered. The UN—that organization which “Western state wisdom had constructed such that Europe’s voice could barely be heard in comparison to the developing countries”? The International Criminal Court at the Hague? “Just to ask such questions,” he said, reflects “the bitterest sarcasm.”
For Röpke, the postwar international system was a faulty construction. Relying on it to enforce just conduct for global capitalism would be fatal.

zh: 勒普克看到的主要障碍不是设计问题，而是更难对付的文化问题。他认为，接受援助的国家根本不存在保障资本安全的道德条件，而且即便在“遥远到连先知也望不见”的未来，这种条件也不会出现。
针对他认为经济发展观念中固有的物质主义，他提出了“道德基础设施”（moral infrastructure）的重要性。
他主张，一些人群具备在全球资本主义体系中取得成功所需的品性，另一些则不具备——而这一点几乎无从改变。
en: The chief obstacle Röpke saw was not one of design but the more intractable one of culture. He argued that the moral conditions simply did not exist in recipient nations to ensure the safety of capital and would not exist into a future “so distant that it could not be seen even with the eyes of a prophet.”
Against what he saw as the materialism of the idea of economic development, he posed the importance of “moral infrastructure.”
Some populations, he argued, had the traits required for success in a system of global capitalism, others did not—and little could change this fact.

zh: 到目前为止，我的叙述集中于法律与经济学如何在“设计一个让资本主义安全的世界”的努力中彼此补充。接下来，我将通过南部非洲与新自由主义之关系这一被人忽视的例子，突出第三个变量——种族变量。在第二次世界大战后的世界重组中，南非与罗得西亚被视为极限个案。当种族等级制作为正式统治策略在全球范围内退潮之时，这两个国家却重新奉行这一策略。1948年引入种族隔离制度（apartheid）之后，南非于1961年退出了英联邦。这一退出几乎获得了一致赞同，尤其是在联合国。
罗得西亚在1965年发表《单方面独立宣言》（Unilateral Declaration of Independence），在白人统治下脱离英国而独立。两国的制度安排在选举权结构和日常管制中都对非白人人口实行歧视。
en: My narrative thus far has focused on the ways in which law and economics complemented each other in attempts to design a world safe for capitalism. Now I will highlight a third term—the variable of race—through the overlooked example of the neoliberal relationship to Southern Africa. South Africa and Rhodesia were seen as limit cases in the reorganization of the world after the Second World War. They reasserted racial hierarchy as a formal strategy of rule even as that strategy receded globally. After introducing apartheid in 1948, South Africa left the British Commonwealth in 1961 under near-universal approbation, especially in the United Nations.

Rhodesia announced a Unilateral Declaration of Independence in 1965, seceding under white rule. Both countries operated through institutional arrangements that discriminated against the nonwhite population in structures of suffrage and everyday regulations.

zh: 尽管遭到国际组织与世界舆论的谴责，南非与罗得西亚所实践的另一种版本的非殖民化，在新自由主义运动中仍不乏辩护者。在这里可以看到MPS内部的一道分裂。一方面，1960年代初白人南非最引人注目的辩护者，正是新自由主义运动的创始人之一——勒普克本人。他之所以变得如此高亢地为南非种族隔离辩护，其思想路径是一段独特的航程，起点是1930年代他与亚历山大·拉斯托（Alexander Rüstow）提出：自由主义需要一个超经济框架（extra-economic framework）作为必要的基底。随着在非殖民化时代重建世界经济秩序的前景令人日益悲观，勒普克在种族据说先天具有的特征中找到了解释，并重新评估了他曾经谴责过的帝国主义。
en: Although condemned by international organizations and world public opinion, the alternative version of decolonization practiced by South Africa and Rhodesia had some defenders in the neoliberal movement. One finds here a split within the MPS. On the one hand, the single most high-profile champion for white South Africa in the early 1960s was one of the founders of the neoliberal movement, Röpke himself. His path to strident advocacy for South African apartheid was an idiosyncratic voyage from the moment in the 1930s when he and Alexander Rüstow called for an extra-economic framework as a necessary substrate for liberalism. Amid deepening pessimism about the potential to restore the global economic order in the age of decolonization, Röpke found an explanation in the supposedly in-built characteristics of race, and reassessed the imperialism he had once condemned.

zh: 勒普克在种族隔离问题上的立场，令他的众多支持者如坐针毡。除了一项例外，近期关于勒普克的学术论著都避而不谈他为南非所作的卖力辩护；一部本应面面俱到的传记对他这段立场只字未提。
他的说辞也与新自由主义运动从1920年代到1980年代的思想史格格不入——在那段历史中，公开为种族等级制辩护只扮演边缘角色。在种族隔离问题上的立场，使勒普克离开了哈耶克、米塞斯、海尔佩林这样的思想家，转而与美国新右派（New Right）的传统主义保守派结盟——尤其是威廉·F.·巴克利，此人也认为反殖民运动和非洲裔美国人在美国争取民权的动员，是对西方文明原则的攻击。
1960年代初，勒普克开始把南部非洲视为全球对抗经济失序的最重要阵地。在他个人对新自由主义与传统主义保守主义的融合之中，南部非洲的白人至上成为保障世界经济的超经济框架的一项本质特征。
en: Röpke’s position on apartheid is uncomfortable for his many supporters. With one exception, recent scholarly treatments of Röpke avoid reference to his spirited defense of South Africa; an otherwise comprehensive biography makes no mention of it.

His rhetoric is also an ill fit with the intellectual history of the neoliberal movement from the 1920s to the 1980s, in which outright defenses of racial hierarchy play only a marginal role. Röpke’s position on apartheid led him away from thinkers like Hayek, Mises, and Heilperin and toward an alliance with the traditionalist conservatives of the U.S. New Right, especially William F. Buckley, who also saw an assault on the principles of Western civilization in anticolonial movements and African American mobilizations for civil rights in the United States.

In the early 1960s Röpke came to see Southern Africa as the most important stand for the global front against economic disorder. In his personal fusion of neoliberalism and traditionalist conservatism, white supremacy in Southern Africa was an essential feature of the extra-economic framework securing the world economy.

zh: 没有另一位新自由主义者完全以勒普克的方式为种族隔离辩护，而且勒普克在发表其最激烈的言论之前已经退出了MPS。然而，其他一些新自由主义思想家确实把两件事区分开来：作为一整套种族分隔体系的种族隔离，与黑人群体的选举权这一具体问题。他们——正如马赫卢普在本章题词中所言——主张，为了维持稳定与繁荣，某些人民的民主权利可能不得不受到限制。
在某些情形下，限制通常意义上的政治自由，是保护经济自由的必要条件。包括米尔顿·弗里德曼、约翰·达文波特和申菲尔德本人在内的知名新自由主义者遵循了这一逻辑，反对在南部非洲实行普遍选举权。
en: No other neoliberal defended apartheid in precisely the way Röpke did, and Röpke had resigned from the MPS by the time he made his strongest statements. Yet some other neoliberal thinkers distinguished between apartheid as a comprehensive system of racial segregation and the discrete matter of suffrage for the black population. They argued, as Machlup does in the epigraph to this chapter, that democracy might have to be restricted for certain peoples in order to preserve stability and prosperity.

Restricting political freedom, as commonly understood, was necessary under some circumstances to preserve economic freedom. Prominent neoliberals, including Milton Friedman, John Davenport, and Shenfield himself, followed this logic by opposing universal suffrage in Southern Africa.

zh: 对平等投票权最重要的批评者，也许令人意外，正是在自由至上主义运动中被颂扬为“南非种族隔离最早、最热烈的反对者之一”的那个人：英国经济学家威廉·H.·哈特，1948年起的MPS成员，曾在伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）求学。
哈特的名声建立在他1964年出版的著作《种族壁垒的经济学》（The Economics of the Color Bar）之上。

这本书虽然主张在劳动力市场中取消歧视，却也提出对选举权加以改造——其灵感明确来自哈耶克——以使市场免于被赋权民众带来的破坏性冲击。从1940年代直到其1980年代去世，哈特一直为南非和罗得西亚鼓吹一种加权选举权（weighted franchise）模式，用以抵消民主的负面影响。哈特的解读得到了其他新自由主义者的支持，他主张一个肤色中立的市场，但只肯让它与一只投票箱并存——这只投票箱先是黑白分明地看人，继而又按贫富给予不同的投票权重。
en: The most important critic of equal voting rights was, perhaps surprisingly, the person celebrated in the libertarian movement as one of “the original and most passionate opponents of apartheid in South Africa”: the British economist William H. Hutt, an MPS member since 1948 who had studied at the London School of Economics (LSE).
Hutt’s reputation is based on his 1964 book

children: The Economics of the Color Bar.

en: While the book advocated nondiscrimination in labor markets, it also proposed a revision of suffrage—inspired explicitly by Hayek—to immunize the market against the disruptive effects of an empowered population. From the 1940s until his death in the 1980s, Hutt promoted a model of weighted franchise for both South Africa and Rhodesia to counteract the negative effects of democracy. Drawing support for his interpretation from other neoliberals, Hutt promoted a color-blind market but only alongside a ballot box that saw first in black and white and then apportioned voting rights differently to the wealthy and the poor.

zh: 我们将考察的针对南非的最后一种回应，来自哈耶克本人。曾两度访问该国的哈耶克，在公开场合毫不含糊地谴责种族隔离“既不公正，也是一种错误”。
但他更严厉的措辞，留给了国际组织试图以制裁和禁运对付实行种族隔离的南非、迫使其改变内部政策的种种努力。比起勒普克搬出“一个种族的世界”，哈特与哈耶克对种族隔离的回应更能体现新自由主义的世界治理方式。哈特提出的对民主的约束，旨在降低经济保护主义与再分配出现的可能性；哈耶克的战斗性全球主义则申明：整体必须挺住，以抵御那种全球化道德的毁灭性要求。
en: The last response to South Africa we will consider here is that of Hayek himself. Having visited the nation twice, Hayek was unambiguous in his public denunciation of apartheid as “both an injustice and an error.”

Yet he saved even stronger words for the attempts by international organizations to use sanctions and embargoes against apartheid South Africa to compel it to change its internal policies. The neoliberal way of world governance was reflected more in the responses of Hutt and Hayek to apartheid than in Röpke’s invocation of a world of races. Hutt offered constraints on democracy designed to lessen the likelihood of economic protectionism and redistribution, and Hayek’s militant globalism affirmed that the totality must hold against the ruinous demands of a globalized morality.

zh: 勒普克与赞比西线
随着非殖民化在世界范围蔓延，作为一个由白人少数派统治的国家，南非受到越来越严厉的国际审视。1960年，南非德兰士瓦地区发生沙佩维尔惨案，警察打死了六十九名抗议种族隔离通行证法的示威者，此后南非禁止了一切反种族隔离团体，于是愈发难以辩称这个国家不是种族主义的警察国家。
美国从1958年起开始正式批评南非政权，当年艾森豪威尔政府首次在联合国签署了反对种族隔离的决议。
学者们梳理了美国政府摇摆不定的立场：它试图通过针对南非的象征性行动——包括1963年的部分武器禁运——来安抚非洲与亚洲的舆论，同时不危及经济联系与政治关系，特别是因为美国依赖南非供应铀和其他战略矿物。
en: As a nation under white minority rule, South Africa came under increasing international scrutiny as decolonization spread worldwide. After the 1960 Sharpeville massacre in the Transvaal region of South Africa, when police killed sixty-nine people who had been demonstrating against the segregationist pass laws, and the subsequent prohibition in South Africa of all anti-apartheid groups, it was ever more difficult to argue that the country was anything other than a racist police state.
The United States criticized the regime formally beginning in 1958, when the Eisenhower administration first signed an anti-apartheid resolution at the UN.

Scholars have traced the wavering line of the U.S. government as it sought to placate African and Asian opinion through symbolic actions against South Africa, including a partial arms embargo in 1963, without endangering economic ties and political relations, not least because it relied on South Africa as a source of uranium and other strategic minerals.

zh: 就在这种气氛中，勒普克于1964年写下他自称的“一次正面评价南非的尝试”。在这本小册子里，他写道：“南非黑人不仅属于一个完全不同的种族，而且同时出自完全不同的文明类型与文明水准。”
勒普克把南非描述为“世界经济中最繁荣、并在某些方面不可替代的国家之一”，称赞“其白人人口的非凡品质——他们生活在异常有利的气候条件下，拥有一种唯有美国才能与之相比的开拓精神”。
这个国家最引人注目的特点是它对游客的吸引力、“相对有利的税制”，以及它给外国投资带来的高回报。
en: It was in this atmosphere that Röpke wrote what he called “an attempt at a positive appraisal” of South Africa in 1964. In the pamphlet, he observed that “the South African Negro is not only a man of an utterly different race but, at the same time, stems from a completely different type and level of civilization.”

Describing South Africa as “one of the most prosperous and—in certain respects—irreplaceable nations in the world economy,” Röpke praised “the extraordinary qualities of its white population, who live under unusually favorable climatic conditions and possess a pioneering spirit that can be compared only with that found in the United States.”
The country’s most notable features were its attractiveness to tourists, its “relatively favorable tax structure,” and the high returns it offered on foreign investment.

zh: 勒普克辩称，种族隔离政策并非压迫。相反，它是“南非依据本国需要推行的‘非殖民化’与‘发展援助’政策的具体形式”。
它之所以必要，是因为南非的非白人“处于这样的发展阶段：这排除了与高度文明的白人之间真正的、精神的与政治的融合；而且他们目前的人数多到足以压倒后者——后者是当下政治、文化与经济秩序的维系者”。
他拿以色列作类比，写道，正如犹太人口与阿拉伯人的关系那样，给黑人群体以完全的政治平等就等于“民族自杀”。
en: The policy of apartheid was not oppressive, Röpke argued. It was instead “the specific form in which South Africa pursues the policy of ‘decolonializing’ and ‘development aid’ which corresponds to this country’s needs.”

It was necessary because the nonwhites of South Africa were “at a stage of development which excludes true, spiritual and political integration with the highly civilized Whites, and are at present in such numbers that they threaten to overwhelm the latter who are present upholders of the political, cultural and economic order.”

Drawing a parallel to Israel, he wrote that, as with the relationship of the Jewish population to the Arabs, to provide full political equality to the black population would be to commit “national suicide.”

zh: 勒普克在1930年代和1940年代的著述中，种族几乎不作为分析范畴出现，而且他曾秉持原则反对反犹主义、并因此流亡离开纳粹德国——在这样的背景之后，看到他在1960年代的政治地理学中把南非颂扬为白人堡垒，不能不令人惊异。
为了防止这个国家沦为“另一个刚果或印度尼西亚”，他呼吁划出一道“赞比西线”，把“非洲大陆由黑人控制的北部与由白人控制的南部分开”。
勒普克相信，出于种族差异、经济利益与现实政治（Realpolitik）的多重理由，白人至上必须在南非延续下去。
en: Following his corpus of writing from the 1930s and 1940s, in which race played little to no role as a category of analysis—and after his principled stance against anti-Semitism that led to his emigration from Nazi Germany—it is striking to see South Africa praised in Röpke’s political geography in the 1960s as a white stronghold.
To prevent the country from turning into “another Congo or Indonesia,” he called for “a Zambezi line” to “divide the black-controlled northern part of the continent from the white-controlled south.”
For reasons of racial difference, economics and Realpolitik, Röpke believed that white supremacy had to persist in South Africa.

zh: 南非政府对这种火力支援感激不尽。他们订制了三种译本，并订购一万六千册将收录这篇论文的书。
第二年，他们又订购了两万份该文章的单篇抽印本，用于在美国散发。
种族隔离的辩护者们在自己的小册子里引用勒普克的著作。
在南非问题上，勒普克无法指望他在欧洲的惯常盟友，因为他与他们的立场背道而驰。《新苏黎世报》（Neue Zürcher Zeitung，
）是瑞士一份主张经济自由主义的报纸，勒普克与该报编辑合作了三十年，但这些编辑并不认同他对亨德里克·维沃尔德政权的热忱。
1964年7月，勒普克在苏黎世一个关于非洲的讲座系列中宣读论文时，这家报纸刊登了一份外国学生的抗议声明。
“这些
的知识分子，非得让一个货真价实的食人生番开口说话才会满意，”勒普克在给他自1960年代中期起的最主要合作者、瑞士企业家兼前MPS欧洲秘书阿尔贝特·胡诺尔德——正是此人组织了那个讲座系列——的信中写道。
勒普克本人还支持该系列中另一位讲者的出场，即德国殖民史学家瓦尔霍尔德·德拉斯赫尔，当人们得知他在第三帝国时期曾出版白人至上主义专著《白色种族的霸权》（The Ascendancy of the White Race）、战后还著有若干为西方殖民主义辩护的文字后，他受到了批评。
在私人通信中，德拉斯赫尔称赞勒普克论南非的文章“出类拔萃”。
en: The South African government was grateful for the rhetorical ammunition. They ordered three translations and sixteen thousand copies of the book in which the article was to appear.
The next year they ordered twenty thousand offprints of the article for distribution in the United States.
Defenders of apartheid quoted Röpke’s work in their own pamphlets.
Röpke could not rely on his usual European allies on the South Africa issue, diverging as he did from their own position. The editors of the economic-liberal Swiss newspaper
with whom he had worked for three decades, did not share his zeal for Hendrik Verwoerd’s regime.
The newspaper published a statement of protest by foreign students when Röpke delivered his paper as part of a lecture series on Africa in Zurich in July 1964.
“These

intellectuals will not be satisfied until they let a real cannibal speak,” Röpke wrote to his primary collaborator from the mid-1960s, Swiss businessman and former MPS European secretary Albert Hunold, who organized the lecture series.

Röpke himself supported the appearance of another speaker in the series, the German colonial historian Wahrhold Drascher, who faced criticism when it was made known he had published a white-supremacist monograph in the Third Reich under the title

children: The Ascendancy of the White Race,

en: alongside later postwar apologia for Western colonialism.
In personal correspondence, Drascher praised Röpke’s article on South Africa as “outstanding.”

zh: 勒普克与胡诺尔德清楚，在南非问题上他们正在与MPS群体的核心分道扬镳。胡诺尔德从南非致信勒普克说，他们昔日的这位新自由主义同道哈耶克“如今主张一人一票，还主张种族混血”。他鄙夷地总结道：“哈耶克的事，我再也不觉得奇怪了。”
在种族隔离问题上，勒普克与胡诺尔德最主要的盟友并不在欧洲的新自由主义圈子里，而是在与之部分重叠的美国新右派的圈子里——这个群体往往更愿意为白人统治的原则辩护。
1950年代，围绕欧洲一体化、战后重建与国际经济等问题，勒普克不断为新兴的美国保守主义运动提供信息。这场运动的两位旗手巴克利和拉塞尔·T.·柯克与勒普克广泛通信、密切合作；1955年，在《国家评论》（
）与《现代时代》（Modern Age）这两份新右派旗舰刊物的首批各期上，勒普克的名字都列在编务名录之中。
1956年，巴克利自称是勒普克的“门徒”。
在通信中，柯克表达了对勒普克影响的感念，称赞他是“使经济思想富有人性”的最大希望。
勒普克那篇关于南非的文章发表之后，自由至上主义报纸专栏作家劳伦斯·费蒂希写信向他祝贺，赞许他写作此文所表现的“勇气”与“伟大的正直”，并承认这篇文章对自己思想“助益良多”。
曾为MPS提议名称的斯坦福大学农业经济学家、流亡美国的德籍学者卡尔·布兰特称这是一次“对自由哲学极其精致、同时又极具力量的阐述”。
巴克利发表自己那篇为维沃尔德政府辩护的文章后写道，对于勒普克给予此文的称赞，他“欣喜若狂”。
en: Röpke and Hunold were conscious of the fact that they were parting with the core of the MPS group on the issue of South Africa. Hunold wrote to Röpke from South Africa that their former neoliberal partner, Hayek, “now advocates one man one vote and race mixing.” He concluded with contempt: “Nothing surprises me about Hayek anymore.”

Röpke and Hunold found their primary allies on the apartheid question not in the European neoliberal milieu but in the partially overlapping circles of the U.S. New Right, a community that was often more willing to defend the principle of white rule.

In the 1950s Röpke was a steady source of information for the emerging U.S. conservative movement on issues of European integration, postwar reconstruction, and international economics. Buckley and Russell T. Kirk, the figureheads of the movement, corresponded and collaborated extensively with Röpke, and in 1955 his name appeared on the masthead of the first issues of both the
and
the New Right’s flagship publications.
In 1956 Buckley declared himself a “disciple” of Röpke.
In correspondence, Kirk expressed his indebtedness to Röpke’s influence and lauded him as the best hope for “humanizing economic thought.”

After Röpke’s South Africa piece was published, libertarian newspaper columnist Lawrence Fertig wrote to congratulate him, commending Röpke’s “courage” and “great integrity” in writing it, which, he acknowledged, had “contributed much” to his thinking.

Stanford University agricultural economist and German émigré Karl Brandt, who had suggested the name for the MPS, called the piece a “very refined and at the same time enormously strong exposition of the philosophy of freedom.”
After Buckley published an article of his own defending the Verwoerd government, he wrote that he was “bursting with pride” over the praise Röpke paid to the piece.

zh: 我们该如何调和勒普克的种族主义与新自由主义的世界秩序话语——后者接受以自由贸易与资本自由流动为条件的民主自决？如第二章所述，勒普克在1930年代对大萧条的思考使他确信，超经济因素对于维系世界经济不可或缺。他觉得，1914年之前，对金本位制的遵奉与资本、商品的自由流动充当了“一种不成文的国际公共秩序（ordre public international）、一个世俗化了的基督教共和国（Res Publica Christiana），并因此遍布全球”，其结果是“世界的政治与道德整合”。
正如一位学者所指出的，这一体系依赖“非正式约束，即超法律的准则、惯例与道德行为规范”的程度，不亚于对各国法律的依赖。
在勒普克看来，国际社会的成员身份与自由市场中负责任的行为者是一回事。作为基督教秩序继承者的自由主义世界秩序，其定义是一套没有正式治理机构加以支配的经济预期与互动模式——它是一个价值共同体，各个经济体可以加入也可以退出，但超国家机构无法通过立法把它创设出来。
en: How do we reconcile Röpke’s racism with the neoliberal discourse of world order, which accepted democratic self-determination on the conditions of free trade and free capital movement? As mentioned in Chapter 2, Röpke’s reflections on the Great Depression in the 1930s led him to see extra-economic factors as essential to the preservation of the world economy. He felt that adherence to the gold standard and the free movement of capital and goods had acted before 1914 as “a sort of unwritten
a secularized Res Publica Christiana, which for that reason spread all over the globe,” resulting in a “political and moral integration of the world.”
As one scholar points out, the system relied as much on “informal constraints, that is, extralegal standards, conventions and moral codes of behavior” as on national laws.

In Röpke’s view, membership in international society was synonymous with being a responsible actor in the free market. The liberal world order, the heir of a Christian order, was defined as a system of formally ungoverned economic expectations and modes of interaction—it was a community of values, which individual economies could both join and leave, but which supranational institutions could not legislate into existence.

zh: 在勒普克把1914年之前的时代描绘成“西方世界光辉灿烂的好日子”的叙述中，有一点处于边缘位置：19世纪同样是帝国主义高峰期，地球上大部分领土被欧洲列强瓜分。
那么，在战后世界，当国际社会的宗教根基已然失落、“西方”共同体又被非殖民化撕裂之时，该怎么办呢？勒普克在1950年代面临的这道难题，也是许多其他保守派——实际上还包括中间派——共同面临的难题：帝国如何终结，而继续控制非白人世界？
勒普克斥责那种欢迎后殖民国家以平等身份加入的民主世界政府方案为西方的求死意志；他写道，“自由世界”不能“被要求自杀”。
en: Peripheral to Röpke’s account of the era before 1914 as the “glorious sunny day of the western world” was the fact that the nineteenth century was also the era of high imperialism, when much of the earth’s territory was partitioned among the European powers.

What was to be done, then, in the postwar world, when both the religious basis of international society had been lost and the community of “the West” was splintered by decolonization? The quandary Röpke faced in the 1950s was shared by many other conservatives and indeed, centrists, as well: How could empire end without losing control of the nonwhite world?

Röpke dismissed the proposal for a democratic world government that would welcome postcolonial nations as peers as a Western death wish; the “free world,” he wrote, could not be “expected to commit suicide.”

zh: 勒普克的一项具体主张是一种联邦形式，其路数与罗宾斯和哈耶克在1930年代开创的方案一脉相承：各国应当拥有正式的政治主权，但经济自主权应予缩减，交由跨境资本与投资的自由流动来调节。
勒普克建议重建后的西德应当以出口为导向，这部分是出于这样一种想法：更容易受到全球市场变动的影响，就会约束大规模、长时期的计划尝试。
他的全球愿景与伯恩哈德·瓦尔彭所见的新自由主义思想的一个基本特征——“重新表述的联邦主义”（rearticulated federalism）——相符，即要求权力分散，以取消那种“对整个社会进行解放性设计”的集体决策能力。
与罗宾斯和哈耶克的设想一样，一个松散的世界联邦有助于阻止大众民意的期望变成现实，因为资本外逃的威胁无处不在，可以抑制扩张性社会政策的种种运动。用脚——也用资产——投票的经济行为者，将成为针对国内福利国家建设规划最可靠的矫正力量。
en: One of Röpke’s concrete proposals was a form of federation along the lines initiated by Robbins and Hayek in the 1930s: Nations should have formal political sovereignty but a diminished economic autonomy that would be regulated by the free flow of capital and investment over borders.

Röpke’s recommendation that a rebuilt West Germany be export-oriented stemmed in part from the idea that susceptibility to shifts in the global market would constrain attempts at large-scale and long-term planning.

His global vision was consistent with the “rearticulated federalism,” seen by Bernhard Walpen as a basic feature of neoliberal thought, that called for the decentralization of authority to remove the collective decision-making capacity for the “emancipatory design of society as a whole.”

As in the vision of Robbins and Hayek, a loose world federation would help prevent mass popular expectations from becoming reality because the ever-present threat of capital flight would curb campaigns of expansionary social policy. Economic actors voting with their feet—and their assets—would be the surest corrective on projects of building domestic welfare states.

zh: 勒普克预言，开放的世界经济所施加的约束，将伴随着文明板块的收缩退守，以回应他所谓的“汉尼拔兵临城下”——由此唤起的是更早一个西方受到威胁的时刻。
勒普克的汉尼拔与其说是苏联——在保守派的德国话语中它常被指为亚洲性的——不如说是正在非殖民化的世界。他写道：“非欧洲大国越是兴起，其他大陆的文明越是开始以居高临下的自信打量我们，欧洲人之间那种精神与道德共同性意识就越会强烈地增强，这也越自然、越必要。”
被围共同体的边界延伸到了大洋彼岸。他断言：“欧洲的精神与政治整合……只有作为大西洋两岸整个西方世界抵抗潜能的更高层级的组合与组织的一部分，才有意义。”
一座道德上强化的“西方堡垒”（Fortress Occident）将作为对日益大胆的非西方人群的必要防御而浮现，因为后者脱离了凝聚西方的那个道德共同体。
en: Röpke predicted that the disciplining function of the open world economy would be accompanied by the retrenchment of civilizational blocs in response to what he called “Hannibal at the gates,” evoking an earlier moment of the West under threat.

Röpke’s Hannibal was less the Soviet Union, often characterized as Asiatic in conservative German discourse, and more the decolonizing world. “The more the non-European great powers emerge,” he wrote, “and the civilizations of other continents begin to regard us with condescending self-confidence, the more it becomes both natural and necessary for the feeling of spiritual and moral homogeneousness among Europeans to increase powerfully.”

The borders of the besieged community extended over the ocean. He asserted that “the spiritual and political integration of Europe … only makes sense as part and parcel of a higher combination and organization of the resistance potential of the
western world on both sides of the Atlantic.”
A morally strengthened Fortress Occident would arise as a necessary defense against the emboldened populations of the non-West, unanchored as they were from the moral community that bound the West.

zh: 勒普克关于西方的规范性愿景，以及他对全球种族格局变动的焦虑，与历史学家所追溯的大西洋主义高度重合——从世纪之交关于英美联合的呼声，一直到1930、1940年代克拉伦斯·斯特赖特（Clarence Streit）关于把美国与英国及西欧联邦融合的设想。
我们将在第六章看到，勒普克反对建立欧洲经济共同体（EEC），理由是它会滋生庞大的官僚机构、壮大西欧的社会主义势力。
取而代之，他主张建立一个包括英国在内的欧洲自由贸易区，并且，与其联邦主义愿景一致，实行自由贸易与货币可兑换，但不设任何超国家的计划机构。
正如一位学者所观察到的，勒普克与路德维希·艾哈德同样认为一体化不应“以大西洋共同体为代价”，并把他们的愿景建立在那种“强调西方在政治、社会与历史上的相似性的西洋（Occidental）观念”之上。
en: Röpke’s normative vision for the West and his anxiety about shifts in the global racial order overlapped considerably with the Atlanticism that historians have traced from turn-of-the-century calls for Anglo-American union to the visions of Clarence Streit for the federalist fusion of the United States with Great Britain and Western Europe in the 1930s and 1940s.
As we will see in Chapter 6, Röpke opposed the creation of the European Economic Community on the grounds that it would bloat bureaucracy and empower socialist tendencies in Western Europe.

Instead, he advocated a European Free Trade Area that would include Britain and, consistent with his federalist vision, entail free trade and convertible currencies but no supranational planning bodies.

As one scholar has observed, Röpke and Ludwig Erhard also believed that integration should not happen “at the expense of the Atlantic Community” and based their vision on the “Occidental concept that emphasized the political, social, and historical similarities of the West.”

zh: 在勒普克看来，西欧与北美因共同的基督教遗产而联结在一起，肩负着恢复1914年后失落掉的自由主义国际经济秩序的责任。其他新自由主义思想家在1945年后淡化了文化与种族的核心地位，勒普克却坚持其重要性。他在1965年写道：“种族狂热并不能成为否认存在所谓族群（ethnos）、种族这类东西的理由，而它具有根本的重要性。”
他所加注引用的文献，在等级制的生物本质主义上毫不遮掩。在他为“民族心理学”（ethnopsychology）开列的推荐书目中，有一项研究的结论是：“适应寒冷与温带气候的民族和种族，心智能力往往足以胜任，而适应炎热气候者则往往不足”；并警告说，由不具备理性思维能力的人民主导的民族国家若掌握“致命权力”，后果堪忧。
在生物学意义上的种族正被诸多社会科学边缘化或重新编码的年代，勒普克却把它拉到了自己分析的中心。
en: Linked by their common Christian patrimony, Western Europe and North America, in Röpke’s view, bore the responsibility for restoring the liberal international economic order lost after 1914. Other neoliberal thinkers downplayed the centrality of culture and race after 1945, but Röpke insisted on its importance. “Racial fanaticism,” he wrote in 1965, “does not justify denying that there is something called ethnos, race, and it is of elementary importance.”

The literature he footnoted was stark in its hierarchical biological essentialism. Among his recommendations for the field of “ethnopsychology” was a study that concluded that “mental capacity tends to be adequate among peoples and races adjusted to cold and temperate climates, but inadequate among those adjusted to hot climates” and warned of “lethal power in the hands of nation-states dominated by populations incapable of rational thought.”
At a time when biological race was being either marginalized or recoded for many of the social sciences, Röpke brought it to the center of his analysis.

zh: 反对全球新政
美国在勒普克重建西方的愿景中扮演着关键角色。然而到了1950年代，他觉得美国政府正竭尽所能加速世界秩序的瓦解。问题始于“新政”。有组织的劳工、保护主义与计划经济使经济过程“政治化”，侵蚀了自由国际经济关系的基础。
干预主义国家是自由世界经济的敌人，因为它试图赋权劳动人口，并在民族国家的领土空间内提高生活水平。在战后时刻，美国政府正在把这些预期输出出去，先是西欧，然后是正在非殖民化的世界。世界经济宪法——国家世界与世界经济之间的严格分立——正在被美国政策所侵蚀。
en: The United States played a key role in Röpke’s vision of a rebuilt West. Yet by the 1950s he felt that its government was doing everything in its power to accelerate the disintegration of world order. The problems had begun with the New Deal. Organized labor, protectionism, and planning had “politicized” economic processes and eroded the foundations of liberal international economic relations.

The interventionist state was the adversary of the liberal world economy because it sought to empower working populations and raise standards of living within national-territorial space. In the postwar moment, the U.S. government was exporting those expectations, first to Western Europe, and then to the decolonizing world. The economic constitution of the world—a firm division between the world of states and the world economy—was being eroded by American policy.

zh: 在美国保守派刊物《自由人》（
Freeman）上他最早发表的文章之一中，勒普克就把矛头对准了战时那个“全球新政”愿景。他援引罗斯福1941年“四大自由”的社会经济承诺，评论道：“真正的自由派不会被诸如‘免于匮乏的自由’这样油滑的辞令所捕获——这类说法把自由的本质交付给了集体主义。”
自《大西洋宪章》公布以来，勒普克就一直担心，用一位学者的话说，“总体战争的另一面”将是“在被动员参战的人们中间对福利国家的广泛期待”。
罗斯福为了赢得战争，把勒普克所谓“平均主义”（equalitarianism）的精灵放出了瓶，再想装回去就难了。赋予民主以经济上的内涵，将给秩序稳定带来灾难性后果。
en: In one of his first articles in the U.S. conservative publication

Röpke took aim at the wartime vision of the New Deal for the world. Citing the socioeconomic promise of Roosevelt’s Four Freedoms from 1941, he remarked, “It is unlikely that the true liberal will be caught by such glib phrases as the ‘Freedom from Want’ by which the essence of liberty is surrendered to collectivism.”

Since the announcement of the Atlantic Charter, Röpke had feared that “the flip side of total war,” as one scholar puts it, would be the “sweeping expectation that there would be a welfare state among those mobilized for war.”

Roosevelt had let the genie of what Röpke called “equalitarianism” out of the bottle to win the war, and it would be difficult to put back in. Filling the category of democracy with economic content would have catastrophically destabilizing effects.

zh: “新政”国际化的第一个后果，就是战后西欧五花八门的计划化实验。
1950年，一位密苏里州参议员在抨击马歇尔计划对英法的援助时，援引了勒普克的这句反讽观察：“马歇尔计划本应把西欧从集体主义、民族主义经济政策的泥沼中拉出来，如今却威胁着在超国家层面制造一种新的超级集体主义。”
勒普克为此场合备制了色彩鲜明的语汇，把美国对欧洲经济共同体计划机构的支持斥为“粗俗的庞然大物崇拜与技术崇拜”。
国际组织则有可能把计划的祸害扩展到更大的规模。1952年，美国企业协会（后来的美国企业研究所）出版了勒普克对联合国《关于实现充分就业的国内与国际措施报告》（1949）的批评，该报告主要由英国与法国的凯恩斯主义者撰写。
勒普克写道：没有别的经济议题“比基于这一误导性、备受激烈争论的充分就业概念更诱人、同时也可能更危险的”；他警告说，这份报告标志着从“国家计划”向“国际计划”的危险转变。
en: The first consequence of the New Deal’s internationalization was the diverse experimentation with planning that emerged in postwar Western Europe.

In an attack on Marshall Plan aid for Britain and France in 1950, a Missouri senator quoted Röpke’s observation of the irony “that the Marshall Plan, which should have pulled Western Europe out of the muck of collectivistic, nationalist economic policy, has threatened to create a new supercollectivism on a super-state level.”
Röpke offered colorful terms for the occasion, denouncing the U.S. support for the planning bodies of the European Economic Community (EEC) as “vulgar gigantolatry and technolatry.”

International organizations threatened to expand the pernicious effects of planning to an even larger scale. In 1952 the American Enterprise Association (later the American Enterprise Institute) published Röpke’s critique of the UN “Report on National and International Measures for Full Employment” (1949), which had been written primarily by British and French Keynesians.

Röpke wrote that there was “no other economic issue which appears so attractive and yet may be so dangerous as the one based on this misleading and bitterly discussed concept” of full employment and warned that the report marked the dangerous shift from “national planning” to “international planning.”

zh: 1961年肯尼迪的“新边疆”（New Frontier）计划启动之后，勒普克又找到一个带“新”字的目标放入批判的瞄准镜。1963年4月，他在《华尔街日报》发表了一篇半版篇幅的社论，题为“华盛顿的经济学：一位德国学者看到国家正滑入财政社会主义”。这篇檄文开宗明义把“新政”与“新边疆”连在一起：“三十年前，我发表过一篇文章，严厉批评罗斯福总统当时以‘新政’之名推行的经济政策。”勒普克接着写道，肯尼迪总统的“新边疆”同样令人担忧。他写道：“‘新政’与‘新边疆’的相似之处，不仅表现在商业信心的普遍低落上，还表现在对‘大政府’毫不掩饰的公开颂扬上，以及服务于这一可疑理想的财政狂热上。”两个计划都屈服于工会不断上涨的工资要求，都奉行扩张货币的通胀政策，体现了“我们这个日益中央集权化的国家如寄生藤蔓般同时缠绕社会与经济体的倾向”。
en: With the launch of Kennedy’s New Frontier program in 1961, Röpke found another “New” entity to place in the crosshairs of critique. In April 1963 he published a half-page editorial in the

titled “Washington’s Economics: A German Scholar Sees Nation Moving into Fiscal Socialism.” The broadside began by linking the New Deal and the New Frontier: “Thirty years ago, I published an article severely criticizing the economic policies then being pursued by President Roosevelt in the name of a ‘New Deal.’ ” The “New Frontier” of President Kennedy, Röpke continued, was no less worrisome. “The similarity between the ‘New Deal’ and ‘New Frontier’ finds expression not only in the general decline in business confidence,” he wrote, “but in an openly defiant glorification of ‘big government’ and in the fiscal megalomania which serves this questionable ideal.” Both programs surrendered to the rising wage demands of trade unions and shared an inflationary policy of monetary expansion that expressed “the tendency for the increasingly centralized state of our times to surround like a parasitical vine both society and economy.”

zh: “新边疆”的特殊危险在于，它字面上就是一个全球新政。循着勒普克的比喻往下说，国家的藤蔓正通过不断扩张的外援计划——政府贷款（到1960年西德伙伴也已被拉入其中）——以及更咄咄逼人地利用工会，包括作为肯尼迪“争取进步联盟”（Alliance for Progress）的一部分而设立美国自由劳工发展研究所，向世界蔓延。勒普克称外国援助是“把集体主义政策的理念与方法推行到世界经济中去的伟大行动”，并点名经济学家贡纳尔·缪尔达尔，说他提议把现代福利国家从西方“移置”（transposition）到勒普克所谓的“未发达”（undeveloped）世界（有意避开带有规范意味的“欠发达”［
developed］一词）。
en: The special danger of the New Frontier was that it was literally a global New Deal. Extending Röpke’s metaphor, one could say that the vines of the state were creeping outward through an expanding foreign aid program of government loans, which had drawn in the West German partner by 1960, and the more aggressive use of trade unions, including the establishment of the American Institute of Free Labor Development as part of Kennedy’s Alliance for Progress. Röpke called foreign aid “the great action by which the ideas and methods of collectivist policy are carried into the world economy” and singled out economist Gunnar Myrdal as proposing the “transposition” of the modern welfare state from the Western to what Röpke called the “undeveloped” world (consciously avoiding the normative term “
developed”).

zh: 在文章中，勒普克点名抨击了凯恩斯增长模型与现代化理论的两位作者——约翰·肯尼思·加尔布雷思和沃尔特·惠特曼·罗斯托，坚称后者宣扬的乃是“披着经济决定论外衣的罗斯福式幻觉主义的新版本……它与马克思的那套东西远不像罗斯托教授自以为的那样相去遥远”。事实上，正因为现代化理论兜售勒普克所谓的“生活水平主义”（standard of life-ism）、内含一种全球经济拉平的许诺，它在“共产主义发展壮大直到达到如今的势力的过程中所起的作用，比共产主义的全副坦克、火箭与师团更为重要”。
换言之，勒普克所谴责的，恰恰是使“发展”在1950年代成为国际共识的那个特点：它专注于增加产出，而没有过细规定实现这个目标的途径。
en: In his article, Röpke attacked by name two authors of the Keynesian growth model and modernization theory, John Kenneth Galbraith and Walt Whitman Rostow, maintaining that the latter preached a “new version of the Rooseveltian illusionism in the dress of economic determinism … which is not nearly as far removed from that of Marx as Prof. Rostow seems to think.” Indeed, by promoting what Röpke called “standard of life-ism,” the promise of global economic evenness contained in modernization theory had “played a more important role in the advance of communism to its present power than has the whole panoply of Communist tanks, rockets and divisions.”

Röpke condemned, in other words, the very feature that made development a consensus internationally in the 1950s: that it concentrated on increasing output without being overly prescriptive about the route used to arrive at the goal.

zh: 勒普克相信，这种把物质主义的进步尺度输出给全球南方、同时对工业化顶礼膜拜的“片面的经济主义”，将导致全球性通胀、世界食品供应的萎缩，并造就一个与自身传统相疏离的全球城市无产阶级。
他认为，一个经济上平等的世界或许根本就不可能，发展中国家也许不得不继续保持不发达，以防世界出现“过度工业化与农业发展不足”（overindustrialization and underagriculturization）的可能。
他补充说，除了一律工业化之后的世界结构性失衡之外，第三世界工业化的条件也并不存在。他用文化本质主义来解释全球贫富差距，写道：“今天‘富’起来的国家之所以富，是因为除了现代技术及其工业应用这些必要的先决条件之外，它们还拥有某种契合其精神［
］的经济组织形式。”
这是一个“令人不快的事实”，但确是现实：这种精神只能存在于“范围受到严格限定的地区……亦即自由世界中完全发达的工业国家”。
用一位学者的话说，勒普克认为全球南方“缺乏准时、守信的品性，缺乏储蓄与创造的倾向”，因此全球南方的工业化方案“注定失败”。
en: Röpke believed that the “one-sided economism” that exported materialist yardsticks of progress to the Global South alongside a fetish for industrialization would lead to worldwide inflation, the erosion of the world food supply, and the creation of a global urban proletariat alien-ated from its own traditions.

He believed that an economically equal world might simply be impossible, and that developing countries might have to remain underdeveloped as a way of preventing a possible “overindustrialization and underagriculturization of the world.”

Beyond the structural imbalance of an entirely industrialized world, he added, the conditions for industrialization in the Third World did not exist. He explained global disparities in wealth through cultural essentialism, writing that “the ‘rich’ countries of today are rich because, along with the necessary prerequisites of modern technology and its industrial use, they have a particular form of economic organization that responds to their spirit [
It was an “uncomfortable fact” but a reality that this spirit could be found only in “sharply curtailed areas … namely the fully developed industrial countries of the free world.”

As one scholar writes, Röpke believed that the “lack of punctuality, reliability, the inclination to save and to create” in the Global South meant that industrialization schemes in the Global South were “doomed to fail.”

zh: 拉齐恩·萨利把勒普克的模式描述为一种植根于超法律行为实践的国际层面的“自下而上的自由主义”。就这一意义而言他是正确的，但他没有看到这一模式内建的文化限制。
在勒普克那里，后殖民国家走向发展——进而走向种种可能的未来——的某些路径从一开始就被取消了资格。在他看来，福利国家精神所内含的平等权利，在全球层面就像在国家层面一样行不通、也不明智。不平等应被理解为资本主义社会无可避免的特征。人们一向认为，现代化理论最大的吸引力之一在于它的“均平的许诺”；而勒普克的模式则把不均衡视为国际分工中不可避免、将长期持续的格局。
en: Razeen Sally describes Röpke’s model as an international “liberalism from below,” rooted in extralegal behavioral practices. While he is correct in this sense, he fails to observe the built-in cultural constraints of the model.

For Röpke, some paths to development, and thus possible futures, for postcolonial nations were disqualified from the outset. In his opinion, the right to equality encapsulated in the ethos of the welfare state was as unworkable and unwise on the global scale as it was on the national. Inequality was to be understood as an unavoidable characteristic of capitalist society. Whereas one of the greatest attractions of modernization theory has been regarded as its “promise of evenness,” Röpke’s model saw unevenness as the inevitable continuing status quo within an international division of labor.

zh: 1963年，三位国会议员在同一天把勒普克抨击肯尼迪的檄文宣读收入《国会记录》（Congressional Record），又有一位在此后数周内照办。
一位极端保守派循着勒普克的思路，把“新边疆”描述为“延续着‘新政’的总体计划”。他指着罗斯托与加尔布雷思问道：“我们的人民会不会醒悟到这些社会主义的设计师、奴役的设计师的图谋，醒悟到足以使我们把航向改回资本主义？会不会呢？”
一位温和派共和党人也利用勒普克的文章批评肯尼迪以及“那套令人厌倦、缺乏想象力、行不通的‘新政’理论”。
勒普克对肯尼迪及其海外政策的煽动性批判，为共和党政策制定者提供了弹药，使反对“新政”的话语战争得以在全球层面展开。
en: Three congressmen entered Röpke’s anti-Kennedy polemic into the Congressional Record in a single day in 1963, and another did so in the following weeks.

One archconservative followed Röpke in describing the New Frontier as “continuing the master plan of the New Deal.” Referring to Rostow and Galbraith, he asked, “Will our people wake up to the designs of these architects of socialism, of slavery, enough to change our course back to capitalism or not?”
A moderate Republican also used Röpke’s article to criticize Kennedy and the “tired, unimaginative and unworkable theories of the New Deal.”
Röpke’s inflammatory critique of Kennedy and his overseas policy provided Republican policy makers with ammunition to fight the rhetorical war against the New Deal on a global level.

zh: 来自另一个欧洲的先知型经济学家

children: THE ECONOMIST-ORACLE FROM THE OTHER EUROPE

zh: 勒普克的文章刊出之时，正值美国保守主义运动加紧动员之际。学者们已经指出，1930年代组织起来反对“新政”的商业保守派，在艾森豪威尔连任、于1958年以“现代共和党主义”之名拥抱凯恩斯主义之后，其运动进入了更公开的阶段。
亚利桑那州参议员巴里·戈德沃特当年以抨击艾森豪威尔的新预算登上全国舞台；1964年竞选总统时，为他充当顾问的正是这样一批德语流亡经济学家的小圈子。
勒普克本人曾为戈德沃特写过一篇揭露性文章，并把他描述为“一支正在改变美国政治整个面貌的力量”。
那年秋天，约翰·伯奇协会成立；MPS则首次在美国开会，地点在普林斯顿大学，资金来自联合果品公司、美国钢铁公司等公司。
这张右翼批评者的网络共享着同一种姿态：因为艾森豪威尔转向凯恩斯主义政策工具，就给他贴上“社会主义者”甚至“共产主义者”的标签。1960年肯尼迪当选，更是放大了这种话语，勒普克在《华尔街日报》文章中使用的“财政社会主义”一词便是例证。
en: The moment when Röpke’s article appeared was one of intensifying mobilization for the U.S. conservative movement. Scholars have shown that business conservatives who organized against the New Deal in the 1930s entered a more public phase of their campaign after Eisenhower’s reelection and his embrace of Keynesianism in 1958 under the moniker of “modern Republicanism.”

Arizona senator Barry Goldwater, who in his 1964 presidential bid would be advised by a coterie of émigré German-speaking economists, entered the national spotlight that year with attacks on Eisenhower’s new budget.
Röpke himself wrote an exposé for Goldwater and described him as “a force that is changing the entire picture of American politics.”
The John Birch Society was formed that fall, and the MPS met in the States for the first time at Princeton University, with the funding of companies including United Fruit and U.S. Steel.

This network of right-wing critics shared a willingness to label Eisenhower “socialist,” if not “communist,” for his move toward Keynesian policy tools. The election of Kennedy in 1960 only amplified the rhetoric, as Röpke’s reference to “fiscal socialism” in his
article illustrated.

zh: 这也是惊慌失措的美国保守派把目光投向西欧、视其为坚持市场原则的堡垒的时刻。新右派中有好几位对欧洲高雅文化怀有强烈的情感认同；对他们而言，勒普克式的新自由主义者代表着“另一个欧洲”，其化身就是西德经济部长路德维希·艾哈德、意大利总统路易吉·艾瑙迪、戴高乐的顾问雅克·吕夫（三人皆为MPS成员）所推行的政策——与多数美国政策制定者相比，他们更相信市场机制，对凯恩斯式需求管理的疑惧也更深。
这些孤立的个人被塑造为勇敢的壁垒；巴克利说，正是勒普克“对自由企业制度矢志不渝的信念，在很大程度上造就了西欧的复兴”。
在1963年一篇《华尔街日报》文章中，保守派记者、MPS成员威廉·亨利·钱伯林把勒普克列为“经济思想中新自由主义潮流的领袖人物之一，这一潮流在促使欧洲各国政府背离集体主义与计划经济的目标和方法方面发挥了重要影响”。
1960年代初，对美国新右派成员而言，美国看起来比欧洲的某些部分——尤其是西德和瑞士——更“社会主义”，而这份功劳要归于一小群经济学翘楚——这一动态在1970年代之后将被颠倒过来。
en: The moment was also one when panicky U.S. conservatives looked to Western Europe as the bastion of market conformism. For New Rightists, several of whom had strong affective identifications with European high culture, neoliberals like Röpke represented the “Other Europe,” embodied in the policies of Economics Minister Ludwig Erhard in West Germany, President Luigi Einaudi in Italy, and De Gaulle adviser Jacques Rueff in France (all MPS members), who professed more faith in market mechanisms and more suspicion of Keynesian demand management than did most U.S. policy makers.

These isolated individuals were cast as brave bulwarks; Buckley said that it was Röpke’s “tenacious faith in the free enterprise system [that] is largely responsible for the recovery of Western Europe.”
In a 1963

article, conservative journalist and MPS member William Henry Chamberlin counted Röpke among “the leaders of the neo-liberal trend in economic thought that has been an important influence in turning European governments away from the goals and methods of collectivism and the planned economy.”

In a dynamic that would be reversed after the 1970s, the United States seemed more “socialist” than parts of Europe—West Germany and Switzerland, in particular—in the early 1960s to members of the U.S. New Right, with credit for this going to a small group of economic luminaries.

zh: 勒普克和其他德语经济学家得益于他们给人的客观印象，以及超然于美国政治混战之外的身份。在勒普克1963年那篇檄文发表后，一封致编辑的信指出，“他的信息更有力，因为它来自一个从容的距离，使人得以不慌不忙地审视局势”。
一家商业信息服务机构把这篇文章寄给订户时，附了如下作者简介：“勒普克自愿离开了纳粹德国，被认为是欧洲乃至当世最杰出的经济学家之一，或许就是其中最杰出的与经济哲学家。多年来，他还深入研究过美国。显然，他并无任何私心要夹带；他住在日内瓦；在任何地方都没有政治抱负；是一位真正的世界主义者。”
欧洲——对勒普克而言尤其是瑞士——以空间的形式，具象化了1960年代初陷入困境的保守派赖以发言的那座本属修辞意义上的堡垒。就MPS而言，这一点是字面意义上的：该学会得名于其首次会议所在的瑞士山峰——《华尔街日报》1972年称之为“思想家栖居之山”。
en: Röpke and other German-speaking economists profited from their perceived objectivity and separation from the scrum of U.S. politics. A letter to the editor after Röpke’s 1963 polemic noted that “his message is the more forceful because it is delivered from a comfortable distance which permits unhurried appraisal of the situation.”

When a business information service sent the article out to its subscribers, it included the following biographical note: “Röpke who voluntarily left Nazi Germany is deemed one of the foremost and perhaps the foremost economist and economic philosopher of Europe, if not our time. He is also for many years one who has concerned himself in depth with the United States. Obviously, he has no ax to grind; he lives in Geneva; has no political ambitions anywhere; and is a true cosmopolitan.”

Europe and, for Röpke, Switzerland in particular, represented spatially the otherwise rhetorical redoubt from which embattled conservatives spoke at the turn of the 1960s. This was literal in the case of the MPS, which took its name from the Swiss peak of its first meeting—the “mountain where thinkers dwell” as the
would label it in 1972.

zh: 勒普克欣然拥抱“另一个欧洲”特使的角色，以及“另一种自由派”——坚守私有财产与竞争原则、而非再分配与社会正义原则的自由派——代表者的角色。三年后，他如此描述自己：“一位来自欧洲中部的经济学家……在他看来理所当然的是，经历了过去几十年的所有阅历与思考之后，除了以讽刺的口吻，已无从谈计划经济、充分就业政策、国有化与福利国家。”
美国人告诉他，他们听惯了“对市场经济的承诺与对社会主义的批判……从商会主席和银行董事嘴里讲出来”，但勒普克已经证明，“一个人可以‘保守’而不必智力粗鄙或缺乏教养，并且能够以一种配得上知识分子身份的方式表达这一立场”。
一位学者认为，对勒普克这类相对冷门的欧洲思想家的认同，帮助美国保守主义运动在1950与1960年代为自己作为一场思想运动的地位取得正当性。
en: Röpke embraced the role of emissary from the “other Europe” and representative of the “other liberals” who held to principles of private property and competition rather than redistribution and social justice. Three years later he described himself as an “economist from the middle of Europe … who saw it as self-evident that, after all of the ex-periences and considerations of the last decades, one could not speak of planned economies, full employment policies, nationalization and the welfare state in anything more than a tone of sarcasm.”

Americans informed him that they were accustomed to hearing the “commitment to the market economy and the critique of socialism … from the presidents of chambers of commerce and bank directors” but that Röpke had proved that “one can be ‘conservative’ without necessarily being intellectually crude or uneducated, and one can represent this position in a way that is worthy of an intellectual.”
One scholar argues that identification with relatively obscure European thinkers like Röpke helped the U.S. conservative movement legitimize itself as an intellectual movement in the 1950s and 1960s.

zh: 勒普克对美国缺乏能够捍卫古典自由主义事业的知识分子自有其解释理论。他把问题的根源归于美国“充满活力的竞争经济”：它创造财富的速度太快，以致学者们被落在了后面，丧失“社会声望”，转而在反资本主义的意见中发泄怨恨。 勒普克注意到，新经济精英的产生快得离谱，以致他对一群富商讲了一个关于魏玛通胀年代暴发户（
）的笑话，但这些人连这个词都不懂，只是一脸茫然。
他把弥合“商业世界与知识生活世界的鸿沟”视为自己的志业，自任新贵（
）的哲人（
en: Röpke had his own theory about the dearth of U.S. intellectuals capable of defending the cause of classical liberalism. He saw the root of the problem in the “dynamic competitive economy” of the States, which was producing wealth so quickly that academics were being left behind, losing “social prestige,” and expressing their resentment in anticapitalist opinions. The creation of new economic elites was happening so rapidly, Röpke noted, that a joke he told about the
during the Weimar inflation years drew blank stares from an audience of wealthy businessmen ignorant of the term.
He took it as a goal to bridge the gap between the “world of business and the world of intellectual life,” offering himself as the
of the

zh: 勒普克通过其著述与公开行动，成了商业保守派公关攻势的一部分。
正是经由这些网络，他进入了一个计划的国际顾问委员会——该计划要在1964年纽约世界博览会上建造一座“自由企业宫”（Hall of Free Enterprise）；其组织者声称，这将“是有史以来第一次把自由经济的全貌以简明、可视的形式呈现出来”。
这座展馆正是经济学家作为永不犯错、中立无倚的信息之源的典范式呈现。它的核心装置是一台计算机，参观者把问题打进去，它就在纸片上打印出答案。《新共和》（
）报道称：“这台机器有一种神谕般的不谬性，比活生生的时评家更令人敬畏。一群肃然起敬的参观者按键提问、阅读答复。他们似乎觉得，机器所说必当真，因为机器总归是无偏无私、不偏不倚的。”
en: Röpke became part of the business conservative public relations offensive through his written work and public actions.

It was through these networks that he became part of the international advisory council for a plan to create a “Hall of Free Enterprise” for the 1964 New York World’s Fair; its organizers claimed it would be “the first time that the totality of a free economy has ever been put together in simple, visual form.”

The hall was a paradigmatic representation of the economist as an unerring, neutral source of information. Its central feature was a computer that would print out answers on slips of paper to questions visitors typed in. The

reported, “There is a kind of oracular infallibility to this machine that makes it more impressive than a live pundit. A group of awe-stricken visitors punched it and read replies. What it said must be so, they seemed to feel, because after all a machine is unbiased and impartial.”

zh: 可以说，德语经济学家在1960年代这个关键时刻——当一次世界性凯恩斯主义的宏大运用遭遇保守派反凯恩斯主义回击之时——也从类似的“神谕般的不谬性”光环中获益。
勒普克一位来自委内瑞拉的通信者，曾在哈佛师从哈伯勒、后来又任职于欧洲经济共同体，称勒普克为“先知”。
一家报纸称他是“自由企业的大祭司之一”，另一家则把他比作“一位高明的医学权威”。
那些为国际金融机构提供咨询、后来又帮助指导结构调整方案的“智者”们享有类似的地位，其专业判断仿佛能够超然于常人的政治纷争。1960年，世界银行派往印度就其五年计划提供咨询的英国、美国和西德三国央行官员，被称为“三位智者”。
1963年设立的联邦德国经济专家委员会（Sachverständigenrat），俗称“五贤人”（Fünf Weisen）。
学者们注意到经济专家享有的特殊声望——1968年出版的一本书称之为“经济学家的时代”。
把计算机和白发苍苍的欧洲知识分子相提并论，表面看似古怪，但二者共享同一种主张：在一个表面上超乎政治之外的空间中生产知识。
en: One could argue that German-speaking economists profited from a similar aura of “oracular infallibility” at this critical moment in the 1960s when an ambitious application of worldwide Keynesianism encountered a conservative anti-Keynesian backlash.
One of Röpke’s correspondents from Venezuela, who studied with Haberler at Harvard and later worked with the EEC, called Röpke a “prophet.”
One newspaper described him as “one of the high priests of free enterprise” and another compared him to “a skilled medical authority.”

The “wise men” who advised international financial institutions and later helped direct programs of structural adjustment enjoyed a similar status, achieving a kind of superhuman detachment in their expertise. In 1960, the West German, American, and British central bankers sent to India by the World Bank to provide advice on its Five-Year Plan were referred to as the “three wise men.”
The West German Council of Economic Experts
created in 1963, was known commonly as the Five Wise Men
Scholars have noted the special prestige enjoyed by economic experts in what a book published in 1968 called “the era of the economists.”
While it might seem superficially odd to pair the computer and the silver-haired European intellectual, they shared the claim of producing knowledge in a space ostensibly beyond politics.

zh: 把战线推向南方
保守派抵抗“新政”政策输出的大西洋战线，在1960年代初向南延伸，试图建立一个与“争取进步联盟”对抗的反制集团。勒普克在这些人中找到了盟友：曾在本地报刊刊登其文章、翻译其书籍与小册子的人，以及一些如今身居要职的昔日学生，例如秘鲁经济部长佩德罗·贝尔特兰。
1963年，勒普克致信他的墨西哥联系人、MPS成员古斯塔沃·贝拉斯科，高兴地表示他的“反肯尼迪主义”在该国已为人知。
他的《华尔街日报》社论在原文刊发一个月后以西班牙语译文出现在委内瑞拉。他的墨西哥出版人——经济与社会分析研究所的尼科梅达斯·苏洛阿加——写道：“由于美国对拉丁美洲的外交政策，我国正面临一大危险。我们认为，那整套政策都建立在拉美经济委员会［ECLA，即联合国拉丁美洲经济委员会］的劳尔·普雷维什先生的著述之上。”
共同的敌人是联合国，以及联合国为其提供空间与资源的平等主义经济学。
en: The Atlantic front of the conservative resistance to the export of New Deal policies extended southward in the early 1960s in an attempt to build a counterbloc to the Alliance for Progress. Röpke found allies among those who had published his work in local newspapers and translated his books and pamphlets, as well as some former students now in positions of power, such as Peruvian economics minister Pedro Beltrán.
In 1963 Röpke wrote to his Mexican contact, MPS member Gustavo Velasco, that he was glad his “anti-Kennedyism” had become known in his country.
His

editorial appeared in Venezuela in Spanish translation one month after its original publication. His Mexican publisher, Nicomedas Zuloaga of the Institute for Economic and Social Analysis, wrote, “We are now facing a great danger in our country with the foreign policy of the U.S. toward Latin America. All that policy, we believe, is based on the writings of Mr. Raúl Prebisch of the ECLA [United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America].”
The shared enemy was the UN and the egalitarian economics for which it provided space and resources.

zh: 勒普克的密切合作者与资助人胡诺尔德，在1962年南美巡回演讲期间看到秘鲁商会买下两千册他的讲稿之后，确信有必要把初现雏形的跨大西洋集团正式化。
他与勒普克开始征询各方对一个名为“大西洋论坛”（Forum Atlanticum）的组织的兴趣。他们希望这个新机构能取代MPS——两人因与哈耶克长期积累的冲突都已退出该学社；勒普克1963年形容学社里满是“知识界的钻营者与阴谋家”。
他们既区别于社会民主主义共识，也区别于既有的、有组织的新自由主义：论坛要更纯粹地代表环绕柯克与巴克利而兴起的那股保守主义——它把自由市场原则与基督教“熔”为一体——而非哈耶克与米塞斯的学说——宗教在这两位那里即便不算缺席，也只属外围之物。在为论坛争取支持的过程中，他们向潜在的合作伙伴贬损奥地利学派，称其学说“没有社会哲学”，把“整全的人”排除在外。
en: Röpke’s close collaborator and funder Hunold became convinced of the need to formalize the emerging transatlantic bloc after the Peruvian Chamber of Commerce bought two thousand copies of his talk during a South American speaking tour in 1962.

He and Röpke began to canvass for interest in an organization they called the Forum Atlanticum. They hoped the new body would replace the MPS, from which they had both resigned in a long-simmering conflict with Hayek; Röpke described the society in 1963 as filled with “intellectual careerists and intriguers.”

Distinguishing themselves from both the social democratic consensus and existing organized neoliberalism, they intended the forum to represent more exclusively the strain of conservatism emerging around Kirk and Buckley—which “fused” free-market principles and Christianity—rather than the philosophies of Hayek and Mises, for whom religion was peripheral if not absent. In trying to build support for the forum, they discredited the Austrians to would-be partners, describing their theories as having “no philosophy of society” and excluding “the human in his entirety.”

zh: 勒普克与胡诺尔德大概希望通过争取天主教精英而抢在MPS前面。胡诺尔德在拟邀成员名单中把南美人列在首位，包括哥伦比亚、委内瑞拉和墨西哥的经济学教授。古巴流亡商人、第一个反卡斯特罗组织的创始人拉斐尔·林康·迪亚斯-巴尔阿特答应加入、出资并替这一事业在拉丁美洲筹款——肯尼迪政府猪湾事件的失败无疑使他心灰意冷。
智利参议员兼大学教授佩德罗·伊瓦涅斯·奥赫达就“争取进步联盟”的威胁与他会谈，这些谈话坚定了胡诺尔德创办新组织的决心。
伊瓦涅斯是美洲贸易与保护委员会的主席；早在芝加哥训练的经济学家们于皮诺切特政变后取得突破之前，该委员会就已在1960年代为他们在智利提供了“基础设施与关系网络”。
除了伊瓦涅斯、柯克、巴克利、托马斯·莫尔纳尔、贝拉斯科、委内瑞拉与哥伦比亚的若干人士，以及《
》杂志的出版人爱丽丝·怀德纳之外，论坛在美国的拟建成员还包括斯坦福的布兰特——他与弗里德曼一样，1964年将成为戈德沃特的经济顾问之一。
胡诺尔德还希望在访问南非期间招募一位“非洲代表”。
en: Röpke and Hunold likely hoped to steal a march on the MPS by appealing to Catholic elites. Hunold listed South Americans first among proposed members, including economics professors in Colombia, Venezuela, and Mexico. Cuban émigré businessman and founder of the first anti-Castro organization Rafael Lincoln Diaz-Balart promised to join, contribute, and raise funds for the endeavor in Latin America, no doubt disillusioned by the Kennedy administration’s failure at the Bay of Pigs.
Conversations with the Chilean senator and university professor Pedro Ibañez Ojeda about the threat of the Alliance for Progress strengthened Hunold’s resolve to start the new organization.

Ibañez was the head of the Inter-American Committee on Trade and Protection, which provided the “infrastructure and network of connections” for Chicago-trained economists in Chile in the 1960s ahead of their breakthrough after Pinochet’s coup.
Aside from Ibañez, Kirk, Buckley, Thomas Molnar, Velasco, individuals from Venezuela and Colombia, and the publisher of
magazine, Alice Widener, other proposed members of the forum in the United States included Brandt, at Stanford, who, like Friedman, would become one of Goldwater’s economic advisers in 1964.
Hunold also hoped to recruit an “African representative” during a trip to South Africa.

zh: 勒普克把拟建“大西洋论坛”的主席一职提议由柯克担任，并解释了自己的想法：“欧洲和两个美洲的头脑……应当携起手来，呈现并凸显我们西方文明的共同遗产，同时坦率地分析并批判那些腐蚀、瓦解这一文明的敌对倾向。”
他此前曾写道，这样做是必要的，以便“让日益美国化、日益左倾的欧洲人了解美国知识分子的意识形态执念——不理解这些，就无法理解肯尼迪那脑损伤式的政策”。
他说，他的老盟友艾哈德——曾任西德经济部长、此时已是联邦总理——没有意识到肯尼迪构成的威胁；艾哈德“像个童子军一样”看待世界政治，并且通过呼吁不发达国家的“所谓必要的工业化”，“混进了不发达国家讹诈的行当”。
勒普克把肯尼迪描述为一个“虚荣的新雅各宾派哈姆雷特、一头聪明的蠢驴、一个毫不掩饰的仇视德国的人（Germanophobe）……身边围着更蠢的驴子，一个没有政治意志的人”，并称华盛顿的政策“几乎不可能有别的样子——就好像它蓄意要在人们闻到气味之前把世界变成共产主义似的”。
他在1962年写道，欧洲生活在“肯尼迪的恐怖”之下。
en: Offering the presidency of the would-be Forum Atlanticum to Kirk, Röpke explained his idea “that the good minds of Europe and of both Americas should … join their forces to present and to bring into focus the common patrimony of our occidental civilization while frankly analyzing and criticizing the hostile tendencies corroding and disintegrating this civilization.”

This was necessary, he had written earlier, “to enlighten the ever more Americanized and sinistrized Europeans about the ideological obsessions of American intellectuals, without which Kennedy’s brain-damaged policies cannot be understood.”

His old ally Erhard, formerly the West German economics minister and now chancellor, did not realize the threat Kennedy presented, Röpke said; Erhard saw world politics “like a Boy Scout” and had “entered the racket of undeveloped countries” by calling for their “supposedly necessary industrialization.”

Röpke described Kennedy as a “vain, neo-Jacobin Hamlet, an intelligent ass, an open Germanophobe … surrounded by even bigger asses, a man without political will” and said that Washington’s policy “could hardly be any different than if it set out to make the world communist before one could smell it coming.”
He wrote in 1962 that Europe existed under the “terror of Kennedy.”

zh: 1964年，“大西洋论坛”收到了令人鼓舞的迹象。胡诺尔德与柯克会见了美国捐赠方——礼来基金会（Lilly Endowment）的约翰·林恩和印第安纳波利斯律师、MPS成员皮埃尔·古德里奇，两人似乎都表示支持。
困难在于物色一位主席。勒普克1962年1月——正值他退出MPS之际——第二次心脏病发作，每况愈下的健康状况使他不大可能出任主席。
柯克表示“愿意起初担任主席一职”，但条件是“实在找不到任何其他合适的人”。他又推辞说自己“正忙于用烈火与刀剑猛攻异教徒，也许由一位不那么凶猛的主席来任职更好”，并提到自己缺乏机构根基，且“终日奔波、没有定所”。
他建议改推布兰特——布兰特1962年已声援勒普克而退出MPS。
然而布兰特当过戈德沃特的顾问，其支持的候选人在1964年11月惨败，他无疑深受震动，对新的事业也心存戒备。当年12月，布兰特致信勒普克，告诉他MPS成员（包括经济事务研究所的创始人安东尼·费舍尔）正在鼓励他重返学社，而他正在认真考虑。
去担任一个实际上是对手的机构的主席，可能会使他永久疏离这个他在1947年帮助命名的学社。
en: The Forum Atlanticum received encouraging signs in 1964. Hunold and Kirk met with U.S. donors John Lynn from the Lilly Endowment and Indianapolis lawyer and MPS member Pierre Goodrich, both of whom seemed supportive.

The difficulty came with finding a president. Röpke had suffered his second heart attack in January 1962 in the midst of his departure from the MPS, and his deteriorating health made him an unlikely candidate.

Kirk offered “to take the presidential office initially,” but only if “no one else at all suitable can be found.” He further demurred that he was “so much engaged in assailing the infidel with fire and sword that it might be better to have a president somewhat less ferocious,” and also cited his lack of an institutional base and his “incessant wandering.”
He suggested Brandt instead, who had left the MPS in solidarity with Röpke in 1962.

Brandt, though, had been an advisor to Goldwater and no doubt was shaken by his candidate’s catastrophic loss in November 1964 and wary of new undertakings. In December of that year, Brandt wrote Röpke to tell him that MPS members (including Antony Fisher, founder of the Institute of Economic Affairs) were encouraging him to rejoin the society, and that he was seriously considering it.
Adopting the presidency of what was, in effect, a rival organization might alienate him permanently from the society he had helped name in 1947.

zh: 美国保守派潜在领袖们不置可否的回应，使“大西洋论坛”的计划陷入危境。
胡诺尔德建议他们积蓄力量、1966年初再试一次，但勒普克的健康持续恶化，并于当年2月去世。
尽管这个组织归于失败，从它拟建网络的各个节点上，我们仍可以看到勒普克如何寻找他的“另一个美国”——在北方的保守派时评家中间，在拉丁美洲的亲商业精英中间；正如他们同样在德语新自由主义经济学家身上找到了他们的“另一个欧洲”。一位学者指出，勒普克为这个新机构物色成员时，瞄准最明确的正是《国家评论》（
）周围的美国保守派。
“大西洋论坛”试图把自由市场自由主义与传统保守主义相结合的项目推向国际，而勒普克认为其最有效的倡导者在美国。通过与新右派的传统主义者结盟，他希望突破他所称的、吸引米塞斯、哈耶克与弗里德曼的信奉者的“经济主义隔都”（economistic ghetto）。
尽管他对美国有种种批评，勒普克其实暗暗钦佩美国新右派进行J. 霍华德·皮尤以其战后保守组织之名所称的那种“精神动员”（Spiritual Mobilization）的能力。
en: The noncommittal response from would-be leaders among U.S. conservatives imperiled plans for the Forum Atlanticum.
Hunold suggested that they gather forces and try again in early 1966, but Röpke’s health continued to decline and he died in February of that year.

Despite the organization’s failure, we can see in the nodes of its proposed network the way Röpke went about finding his “Other America” in the conservative pundits of the North and the pro-business elites of Latin America, just as they found their “Other Europe” in German-speaking neoliberal economists. One scholar notes that Röpke most pointedly targeted the American conservatives around the
for membership in the new entity.

The Forum Atlanticum represented the would-be internationalization of the project fusing free-market liberalism with traditionalist conservatism, whose most effective advocates Röpke saw in the United States. Allying with the traditionalists of the New Right, he hoped to break out of what he called the “economistic ghetto” of the libertarians attracted to Mises, Hayek, and Friedman.

For all his criticism of the United States, Röpke implicitly admired the American New Right’s capacity for what J. Howard Pew called, in the title of his postwar conservative organization, Spiritual Mobilization.

zh: 1964年，胡诺尔德在美国中西部巡回演讲途中致信勒普克说，他不得不改掉在伊利诺伊州皮奥里亚一场演讲的名称。原定题目——“欧洲经济一体化”——让当地电视台台长忍不住问道：“你们那边也有种族问题吗？”胡诺尔德指出，美国人最关心的莫过于“融合与隔离”问题。
事实上，种族问题与经济秩序问题的交汇，正是这一时期勒普克关切的前台。这位经济学家以敢持不受欢迎立场、敢于“逆潮流而行”自诩（他的回忆录经亨利·雷格纳利出版社译成英文出版时，书名就是《逆潮流而行》[Against the Tide]）。
在南非问题上尤其如此。从1964年直到1966年去世，勒普克对外国援助与“西方文明”（occidental civilization）的关切在南部非洲汇到了一起。
en: In 1964 Hunold wrote to Röpke from a speaking tour through the U.S. Midwest that he had to change the name of one of his lectures in Peoria, Illinois. The title—“European Economic Integration”—had prompted the director of the local television station to ask, “Do you fellows have a racial problem over there too?” Hunold pointed out that people in the States were preoccupied above all “with integration and segregation.”

In fact, the intersection of questions of race and economic order were at the forefront of Röpke’s concerns in this period. The economist prided himself on taking unpopular positions and being “against the tide” (as his memoir was titled when published in English by Henry Regnery).
This was certainly the case in the matter of South Africa. From 1964 until his death in 1966, Röpke’s concerns about foreign aid and “occidental civilization” converged in Southern Africa.

zh: 历史学家已经表明，《国家评论》在1950年代末于种族议题上向右急转，其顶点是巴克利1957年那篇反对废除种族隔离的社论：其理由是白人属于“先进的种族”，而科学证明了“白人相对于黑人的文化中位数优势”。
但人们很少注意到，巴克利这篇社论是包裹在为欧洲对非洲的殖民主义辩护之中的。巴克利为英国在肯尼亚维持殖民统治的行径（此举一直延续到1964年）辩护，称之为给美国南方树立的榜样——“文明的要求高于普选权的要求”；并以一个毫不掩饰的反民主论证为全文作结，主张白人至上：“对世界上任何地方的任何共同体来说，肯定并践行文明的标准，比俯顺数量多数的要求更为重要。”
正如一位学者所言，巴克利的种族观点“并不止步于水边”。他在1960年代拿着报酬赴南非执行“实地考察”任务，并散发支持南非种族隔离政府的出版物。
巴克利疾呼“南方必须获胜”，其意也包括白人必须在全球南方获胜。
en: Historians have shown how the

tacked to the right on issues of race in the late 1950s, culminating in Buckley’s 1957 editorial opposing desegregation on the grounds that whites were “the advanced race” and that science proved “the median cultural superiority of White over Negro.”

Yet they rarely note that Buckley’s editorial is couched in a defense of European colonialism in Africa. Buckley defended British actions for maintaining colonial control in Kenya (which continued until 1964) as an example to the U.S. South that “the claims of civilization supersede those of universal suffrage,” and concluded with an openly antidemocratic argument for white supremacy: “It is more important for any community,
to affirm and live by civilized standards, than to bow to the demands of the numerical majority.”

Buckley’s racial views “did not stop at the water’s edge,” as one scholar notes. He visited South Africa on paid fact-finding missions in the 1960s and distributed publications supporting the apartheid government.
Buckley’s exhortation that “the South must prevail” also meant that whites had to prevail in the Global South.
