zh: 对于世人容忍非白人行为体在世界舞台上提出种种主张，勒普克常常愤懑难抑，流为恶言毒语。1963年，他对美国政客在南非问题上“向黑人酋长们卑躬屈膝”的景象表示“厌恶”。他写道：“号召南非黑人‘平等’，就是一种自杀号召。认清这一点的人如此之少，令人悲哀。”

勒普克身后，其名望仍继续为种族隔离辩护者的活动增添欧洲知识界的光彩。例如，俄亥俄州共和党联邦众议员、“推举戈德沃特”（Draft Goldwater）运动的领袖约翰·M.·阿什布鲁克1967年将极右翼组织“美国—非洲事务协会”（AAAA）编印的关于南非的一批文件载入《国会记录》。该协会由《国家评论》出版人威廉·拉舍尔和非裔前共产党员马克斯·耶根创立，专为南部非洲的白人统治游说辩护；其核心成员正是勒普克自1940年代以来就有往来的那批新右派翘楚，其中包括柯克、雷格纳利、钱伯林与亨利·黑兹利特。
阿什布鲁克援引“受人尊敬的经济学家”勒普克的话，称南非并非“愚蠢或邪恶”。
阿什布鲁克还提请人们注意向种族隔离南非施加压力的经济后果，他说：“联合国似乎几乎没有考虑过，如果大陆上最先进、最有生产力的部门被制裁或战争打乱，全体非洲黑人将面临怎样的经济灾难——顺带说一句，那还将同时砸碎英国经济，终结其对非洲的大量援助。”
按照阿什布鲁克这套有勒普克言论背书的逻辑，为了黑人自身的经济利益，必须维持那个剥夺他们权力的种族主义制度。
en: Röpke’s frustration with the tolerance for the claims that nonwhite actors were making on the world stage frequently tipped over into vitriol. In 1963 he expressed “disgust” at the sight of American politicians “groveling in front of the Negro chiefs on the South Africa issue.” “To call for ‘equality’ of the blacks in South Africa is a call for suicide,” he wrote, “It is saddening how few people have realized that.”

Röpke’s name continued to add European intellectual luster to the campaign of apartheid apologists after his death. For example, U.S. Representative John M. Ashbrook (R-Ohio), leader of the Draft Goldwater movement, entered a collection of documents about South Africa by the ultra-conservative American-African Affairs Association (AAAA) into the Congressional Record in 1967. Founded by

publisher William Rusher and African-American former Communist Max Yergan to advocate on behalf of white rule in southern Africa, the AAAA included the core group of New Right luminaries that Röpke had been in contact with since the 1940s, among them Kirk, Regnery, Chamberlin, and Henry Hazlitt.
Ashbrook cited Röpke, “the respected economist,” as stating that South Africa was “not ‘stupid or evil.’ ”

Ashbrook further called attention to the economic consequences of pressuring apartheid South Africa, saying that “little consideration seems to have been given by the UN to the economic disaster which would ensue for all black Africans if the most advanced and productive sector of the continent were disrupted by sanctions or war—which would incidentally concomitantly smash the British economy and end its substantial aid to Africa.”
In Ashbrook’s logic, supported by reference to Röpke, upholding the racist system that disempowered them was economically necessary for the black population itself.

zh: 如前所述，勒普克把“南非黑人”描述为“一个种族完全不同的人”，“出自完全不同的文明类型与文明水准”。如此直白的进化论种族主义表述在印刷品中相对少见。对勒普克而言更常见的，是他把种族转译成经济学。这一框架在他1966年——即他去世那一年——发表在《现代时代》（

）上的一篇论文中体现得尤为明显。他痛惜“基督教共和国”（republica Christiana）的失落，在一个世俗时代它已不能再充当社会互动的基底；但他向读者保证，在“欧洲及欧洲人海外拓居的国家”仍有一个“国际秩序”存续着，而除此之外便只有“一片狼藉”。他用刚果的例子来说明他借以把发展中世界与已非殖民化世界排除在国际秩序之外的原则：“只要刚果还通过比利时与西方的国际秩序相连，比利时政府提供的担保就使下述做法成为可能：以负担正常利息的惯常贷款方式，在自由资本市场上筹集刚果经济发展与现代化所需的大笔资金。”接着，他把这一早先“被纳入”的时刻与1960年代中期对照：彼时的刚果，已“因一次草率而惊慌失措的‘非殖民化’行动，被从西方的国际秩序中切断”。在这种情况下，“根本不可能设想有任何利率，能让西方国家的人愿意自愿地把钱贷给那个国家——正如他们同样不会愿意贷给印度、埃及或印度尼西亚一样”。
en: As we saw earlier, Röpke described the “South African Negro” as “a man of an utterly different race” who “stems from a completely different type and level of civilization.” Such crude statements of evolutionary racism were relatively rare in print. More common for Röpke was his translation of race into economics. This framework is especially evident in an article published in

in 1966, the year of his death. Lamenting the loss of the “republica Christiana,” which could no longer be relied on as the substrate of social interaction in a secular age, he assured readers that there still was an “international order” that persisted in “Europe and the overseas countries of European settlement,” although outside of this there was only “debris.” He explained the principle by which he excluded the developing and decolonized world from the international order through the example of the Congo: “As long as the Congo was connected with the international order of the West through Belgium, the guarantee offered by the Belgian government made it possible to raise the enormous sums needed for the economic development and modernization of the Congo largely on the free capital markets by way of the usual loans bearing a normal rate of interest.” He then contrasted this earlier moment of inclusion with the mid-1960s, by which time the Congo, “by an ill-considered and panicky act of ‘decolonization,’ has been severed from the international order of the West.” Under this circumstance, there was “simply no rate of interest conceivable at which people in the Western countries might be persuaded to lend their money voluntarily to that country any more than they would to India, Egypt, or Indonesia.”

zh: 勒普克把一个民族与“西方”的远近问题，蒸馏为一个数字：这个国家借钱必须支付多少利息。对他来说，最切要的判准既不是文化，也不是意识形态或地理，而是信用。他把这层意思说得毫不拐弯，称利率是“对一国加入‘自由世界’阵营之资格的量化”。
因为在勒普克眼中，企业家品质、作为文明范畴的西方、自由市场的运转三者之间存在完全的同构关系，利率便不仅是经济指标，更是精神指标——一种 Geist（精神）的指数。世界银行及其他国际金融机构通过提供低息贷款与国家间融资，正是在篡改世界秩序的中枢机制。这种对“自由世界”的经济定义——把“西方”转译成一个金融范畴——构成了勒普克公开处理南非问题的底色。
en: Röpke distilled the question of a nation’s proximity to “the West” down to the figure of how much interest the nation would have to pay to borrow money. For him the most pertinent criterion was not culture, ideology, or geography but creditworthiness. He phrased the sentiment baldly, calling the interest rate “a quantification of one’s right to membership in the bloc of the ‘free world.’ ”

Because Röpke saw a perfect homology between the qualities of entrepreneurship, the civilizational category of the West, and the functioning of a free market, interest rates were not just an economic but a spiritual index, an index of

By offering low-interest loans and state-to-state financing, the World Bank and other international financial institutions were tampering with the central mechanism of world order. This economic definition of the free world—the translation of “the West” into a financial category—underwrote Röpke’s public treatment of South Africa.

zh: 勒普克的修辞在1965年11月罗得西亚白人政府发表《单方面独立宣言》、随之迎来国际谴责与英国制裁呼吁之后达到顶点。勒普克在日内瓦招待南非经济部长伉俪之际致信胡诺尔德，评说道：“在令人作呕的罗得西亚个案中……意识形态、偏执、虚伪、愚蠢与受虐倾向的组合已攀上新高度。要是一个白人‘发展中国家’证明了发展援助并无必要，那就非把它毁灭不可。”
胡诺尔德表示，他正在游说艾哈德阅读勒普克论南非的著作，以期改变他对罗得西亚的看法。
胡诺尔德重申，南非“无论现在还是将来，都将在‘自由世界’的存续与西方文化的延续中扮演重要角色”。
他把罗得西亚的事态比作“三十五年前完全相同的危险关口——那时纳粹党赢得了第一次重大选举胜利，此后德国各阵线便被系统地削弱了”。
换言之，白人阵营正在动摇，预示着一场种族战争可能肇始——这次不是德国人对付犹太人，而是黑人对付白人。在胡诺尔德看来，赞比西线构成了新的马奇诺防线，非白人则是新的纳粹。
en: Röpke’s rhetoric climaxed in the wake of the white Rhodesian government’s Unilateral Declaration of Independence in November 1965, along with the international criticism and British calls for sanctions that greeted it. Writing to Hunold as he entertained the South African economics minister and his wife in Geneva, Röpke observed, “[In] the revolting case of Rhodesia … the combination of ideology, obsession, hypocrisy, stupidity and masochism has reached a new height. If a white developing country proves that development aid is unnecessary, then [the country] has to be destroyed.”
Hunold said he was lobbying Erhard to read Röpke’s work on South Africa so that it might change his mind about Rhodesia.
Hunold reaffirmed that South Africa would “play an important role for the survival of the free world and the perpetuation of Western culture now and in the future.”

He likened the happenings in Rhodesia to “the same dangerous point as thirty-five years ago, when the National Socialists achieved their first great electoral success, and after which the fronts in Germany were systematically weakened.”

The white bloc, in other words, was wavering, signaling the potential beginning of a race war, not of Germans against Jews this time but of blacks against whites. To Hunold, the Zambezi line constituted the new Maginot Line and nonwhites were the new Nazis.

zh: 勒普克的另一位通信者、社会学家赫尔穆特·舍克，也在胡诺尔德组织的苏黎世讲座系列上讲过演，他在第二次世界大战的结局与正在非殖民化的当下之间看到了一条直接关联。他觉得，西方知识分子对非白人人口的声援——他称之为“亲非洲癖”（Afrophilia）——其实是“一种迟到的、完全错置的忏悔姿态，来自那些感到羞愧的人和群体：当希特勒迫害犹太人时，他们没能及时而有效地制止迫害”。舍克在给勒普克的信中断言，由于这些知识分子想法子弥补过去的过错，“由于我们许多同行潜意识中的一种奇异的颠倒，今天非洲人（有色人种）被赋予了希特勒以杀害犹太人实际摧毁的全部智慧和文化潜能”。舍克相信，这种求和姿态的结局，将是加速白人人口字面意义上的灭绝。他警告说：“先让食人者取代他们，再把大致相同人数的白人送去做他们的盛宴，也不能让六百万犹太人起死复生。”
en: Another of Röpke’s correspondents, sociologist Helmut Schoeck, who also spoke in the Zurich lecture series organized by Hunold, saw a direct relationship between the outcome of the Second World War and the decolonizing present. He felt that solidarity of Western intellectuals with nonwhite populations—or “Afrophilia” as he called it—was actually a “tardy and completely misplaced gesture of repentance of those people and groups who are ashamed because they failed to intervene at the right time and with any success in Hitler’s persecution of the Jews.” Schoeck averred in a letter to Röpke that because those intellectuals were seeking to make up for a past error “thanks to a strange inversion in the subconscious of many of our colleagues, the Africans (coloreds) today have been attributed all of the intelligence and cultural potential that Hitler actually did exterminate in the Jews.” This attempt at a con-ciliatory gesture would end by accelerating the literal extinction of the white population, Schoeck believed. “You cannot bring six million Jews back to life,” he cautioned, “by first putting cannibals in their place and then serving approximately the same number of Whites to them as a feast.”

zh: 在勒普克的保守派熟人圈子里，“食人生番”一词被频繁用来指称非洲政治行为体，加上他呼吁划定“赞比西线”，以及“西方的自杀”这一挥之不去的主题，凡此种种都表明：种族化的世界观正是勒普克战后社会与经济哲学的核心。他论南非的著述，连同这些著述获得新右派的热烈赞同，使文化地理与经济地理诸范畴的交叉显现无遗。勒普克背离了米塞斯的立场——米塞斯在战后著作中反对把种族用作分析范畴——也背离了哈耶克的立场——哈耶克作《我为何不是保守主义者》（Why I Am not a Conservative）一文，正是为了同勒普克的通信者拉塞尔·柯克划清界限。
由勒普克开创的那种新自由主义变种，与我们一路考察至今的普世主义全球主义相去甚远；但如下文所示，新自由主义对南部非洲白人统治的辩护，能够并且确实采取了其他形式。
en: The frequent use of the term “cannibal” in Röpke’s circle of conservative acquaintances, to describe African political actors, alongside his call for a “Zambezi line” and the persistent refrain of the “suicide of the West,” suggests that a racialized worldview was at the heart of Röpke’s postwar philosophy of society and economy. The intersections of the categories of cultural and economic geography come to light in his writings about South Africa and their hearty approval by the New Right. Röpke had broken with the position of Mises, who in his postwar work opposed the use of race as a category of analysis, and Hayek, who wrote his talk “Why I Am not a Conservative” explicitly to distance himself from Röpke’s correspondent Russell Kirk.

The variety of neoliberalism pioneered by Röpke was distant from the universalist globalism we have been exploring, but as the next section shows, the neoliberal defense of white rule in Southern Africa could and did take other forms.

zh: 勒普克那种直白的生物种族主义表述，并非新自由主义者中的常态。
与这位种族隔离辩护者最醒目的对位人物，看似应是威廉·H.·哈特——《新个人评论》（New In
）1964年称他为“种族隔离政策一贯的反对者”。

哈特的主要著作《种族壁垒的经济学》（The Economics of the Color Bar）1964年出版，1980年代末由经济事务研究所再版，2007年又由路德维希·冯·米塞斯研究所再次刊行。哈特与勒普克、哈耶克生于同一年。他生于1899年，在伦敦政经学院师从西奥多·格雷戈里与埃德温·坎南；1928年加入开普敦大学（UCT）教职，与同为伦敦政治经济学院校友的阿诺尔德·普兰特共事。普兰特是朝圣山学社的创始成员，于1930年返回伦敦政治经济学院任教授。
哈特在开普敦大学的学生之一是巴兹尔·亚梅，后者成为批评发展援助的著名新自由主义者，与彼得·鲍尔合写过论文。
哈特留在开普敦大学直到1966年，此后在美国一系列职位上任职；任职最久的是达拉斯大学，他从1972年起在那里担任杰出访问教授，直到1988年去世。哈特对经济学的主要贡献，是他的“消费者主权”概念，以及关于工会的研究和“闲置资源理论”。
en: Röpke’s forthright statements of biological racism were not the norm among neoliberals.
The most notable counterpoint to the apartheid apologist would seem to be William H. Hutt, described by the New In
in 1964 as a “consistent opponent of the policies of apartheid.”
Hutt’s main book,

children: The Economics of the Color Bar,

en: was published in 1964 and reissued by the Institute of Economic Affairs in the late 1980s and again by the Ludwig von Mises Institute in 2007. Hutt was an exact contemporary of Röpke and Hayek. Born in 1899, he studied at the LSE with Theodore Gregory and Edwin Cannan and in 1928 joined the faculty at the University of Cape Town (UCT); he worked there with former fellow LSE student Arnold Plant, who was a founding member of the MPS and would return to the LSE as a professor in 1930.
One of Hutt’s students at UCT was Basil Yamey, who became a prominent neoliberal critic of development aid, coauthoring articles with Peter Bauer.

Hutt stayed at UCT until 1966, when he moved to a series of positions in the United States. His longest stint was at the University of Dallas, where he was a distinguished visiting professor from 1972 until his death in 1988. Hutt’s primary contribution to economic thought was his notion of “consumer sovereignty,” as well as his work on trade unions and his “theory of idle resources.”

zh: 自1930年代起，哈特便经由伦敦政经学院与这群新自由主义知识分子相连。哈耶克1954年编定的文集《资本主义与历史学家》（Capitalism and the Historians）收录了他的一篇文字。哈特1948年成为MPS成员，1949年至1984年间在八次年会上发言，就“自由主义与种族主义”（1964）、“南非企业家形象”（1970）等题目提供专门意见。用他自己的话说，他不仅出席了MPS的第二次会议，而且参加了“其后绝大多数历次会议”。
旅居南非期间，他接待过哈耶克，是新自由主义运动在非洲的头号联系人。
en: Hutt was connected to the neoliberal intellectuals through the LSE since the 1930s. Hayek included a piece of his in the 1954 collection

Hutt became an MPS member in 1948 and from 1949 to 1984 presented at eight annual meetings, where he offered his expertise on topics such as “liberalism and racialism” (1964) and “the image of the entrepreneur in South Africa” (1970). By his own account, he attended not only the second meeting of the MPS but the “great majority of all subsequent conferences.”
During his time in South Africa, he hosted Hayek and was the key contact for the neoliberal movement in Africa.

zh: 在《种族壁垒的经济学》——他把新自由主义思想应用于南非个案最为系统的著述——中，哈特有意识地运用了米尔顿·弗里德曼论美国种族主义的见解，并呼应了加里·贝克尔同一时期的观点。
后来的学者追忆此书，称之为一部“唤起良知之作”，一部“深刻而令人不安的分析，揭露了南非种族隔离的道德恐怖”。
哈特论证的核心是：种族主义是一种寻租形式，与工会捍卫自身特权、阻止非白人劳工进入相关行业相类似。
哈特提出，“肤色歧视的主要根源”在于“捍卫经济特权的天然冲动”。
在他的解读中，种族主义并非出自市场，而是在市场之外——并且与市场对立。在一篇书评中，MPS同仁伊诺克·鲍威尔盛赞哈特这部书印证了：“市场经济……是个人之间、阶级之间、种族之间歧视的最有效的敌人。”
en: In

children: The Economics of the Color Bar,

en: his most extensive application of neoliberal thought to the case of South Africa, Hutt self-consciously applied insights from Milton Friedman about U.S. racism and echoed those of Gary Becker from the same time.
Latter-day scholars recall the book as a “conscience-raising work” and a “profound and disturbing analysis that exposed the moral horror of apartheid in South Africa.”
At its core, Hutt argued, racism is a form of rent-seeking analogous to trade unions defending their own privilege against the entry of nonwhite workers.
“The chief source of colour discrimination,” Hutt suggested, was “to be found in the natural determination to defend economic privilege.”

In his reading, racism was not of the market but outside of—and in opposition to—the market. In a review, fellow MPS member Enoch Powell praised Hutt’s book as a testament that “the market economy … is the most effective enemy of discrimination between individuals, classes and races.”

zh: “市场不辨肤色”——这是哈特得出的结论。

他颂扬劳动力流动的美德，抨击种族隔离那带有种族色彩的带有排他性的“封闭雇佣制”（closed shop）。与其早期著作一脉相承，哈特把模型建立在消费者与雇员双重主权之上。然而，哈特在谴责种族隔离的同时，也为它下了一个极其特殊的定义。在他那里，平等等同于拆除就业场所中的种族壁垒，而绝不等于满足任何政治诉求。他的倾慕者对其避而不谈——但他围绕这一主题的其他著述几乎全部聚焦于此——那就是：与工作场所解放相配套的政治安排，并非黑人的平等，而是他们在可预见的未来居于二等地位。哈特的加权选举权方案，最终和勒普克的利率文明指数论一样激进。
en: “The market is color-blind” was the conclusion Hutt came to.

He celebrated the virtues of labor mobility and attacked the racialized “closed shop” of apartheid. Consistent with his earlier work, Hutt built his model around the sovereignty of both consumer and employee. Yet even as Hutt condemned apartheid, he defined it in a very particular way. For him, equality was synonymous with lifting racial barriers to employment in the workplace rather than any the fulfillment of any political demand. Tactfully avoided by his admirers—but the focus of nearly all of his other writing on the theme—is the fact that the political complement to this workplace liberation was not equality for blacks but their second-class status for the foreseeable future. Hutt’s proposals for a weighted franchise ended up being just as radical as Röpke’s proposition of the interest rate index of civilization.

zh: 民主问题是哈特著述的中心主题。他在《种族壁垒的经济学》中称为“我全部论旨中最要紧的一点”的，并非经济学论证，而是一种政治论证：警告在普选制度下会出现“议会多数的暴政”。
在他看来，黑人恰恰是南非的多数人口，这使得局势格外凶险。普选这个表面上的解决办法，只会“意味着把权力移交一个新的政治多数，而没有任何宪政限制来防止报复性的滥用”。
哈特提到，他同情那些担心“黑人至上（不过是主客易位）”的人。
哈特在为《国家评论》应约撰写的文章中详细阐述了这些想法。约稿很可能来自巴克利本人，当时他在1962—1963年冬天进行一次由国家出资的南非之行。
在这篇未刊发、题为《南非的种族隔离及其外国批评者》（Apartheid in South Africa and Its Foreign Critics）的文稿中，哈特辩称，在南非引入一人一票，将导致他声称苏联人正在鼓励的“黑人帝国主义”。
哈特表示需要“保护少数群体（即白人）免受劫掠与报复”，并建议按“某种加权原则”调整选举权。
哈特在1957年致《开普敦时报》（
）编辑的一封信中就其方案给出了更多细节。他提出对欧洲裔与非欧洲裔选民都设置教育程度的选举资格门槛，但至关重要的是：“在遥远未来的某个时刻（把五十年说出口都已过于乐观），当非欧洲裔选民的总数与欧洲裔选民相当时，每一张非欧洲裔选票的价值便开始渐进而极其缓慢地递减。”
这是一个递减比例的代表模式；它即便不能维系白人少数统治，至少也能保证一张白人选票比一张非白人选票更有分量。
en: problem of democracy was the central theme of Hutt’s writings. What he described as “the most vital point of my whole thesis” in
was not an economic but a political argument: a warning about the “tyranny of parliamentary majorities” under systems of universal suffrage.
fact that blacks were the majority population in South Africa made the situation exceptionally perilous, in his view.
apparent solution of universal suffrage would only “mean the transfer of power to a new political majority,
Hutt mentioned that he sympathized with those who feared “black supremacy (a mere turning of the tables).”
Hutt expanded on these ideas in a piece solicited for the Na
likely by Buckley himself on his state-funded trip to South Africa in the winter of 1962–1963.

In a draft of the unpublished piece, titled “Apartheid in South Africa and Its Foreign Critics,” Hutt argued that the introduction of one-man-one-vote in South Africa would lead to what he said the Soviets were encouraging: “black imperialism.”
Hutt expressed the need “to protect the minorities [that is, Whites] from spoliation and revenge” and suggested that the franchise be adjusted on “some principle of weighting.”
Hutt offered more details on his proposal in a letter to the editor of the

in 1957. He suggested an educational requirement for franchise for European and non-European voters, but, critically, “at some time in the distant future (it would be very optimistic to assume 50 years) when the aggregate number of non-European voters equaled that of the Europeans, the value of each non-European vote would begin gradually and very slowly to diminish.”
model was one of degressive proportionality, and it would preserve, if not white minority rule, then a greater value for a white ballot than a nonwhite one.

zh: 在哈特眼中，与自己哲学最接近的人是哈耶克。1963年哈耶克到访南非之前，哈特就把文章草稿寄给了他。哈特称哈耶克1960年的著作《自由秩序原理》（
）是“限制民主之必要”这一原则“最伟大的阐述”。
在那本书里，哈耶克勾画了民主可能出现的越界，论证时兼取历史与当下。他先援引中欧的近期历史，说自己“目睹千百万人用选票把自己投入暴君的完全依附之中，我们这一代人因此明白了：选择自己的政府，并不必然等于确保了自由”。
接着他对后殖民各国政府来了一句含蓄的讥刺：“尽管民族自由的概念与个人自由的概念 相似，却并不相同；而对前者的追求，并未总是增进后者。”他观察到，非殖民化与民主自决可能带来糟糕的后果：“它有时使人们宁取本民族的一个专制者，也不愿接受异族多数的自由主义政府。”
en: The person Hutt saw as being closest to his philosophy was Hayek, with whom he shared the draft of the article ahead of hosting him in South Africa in 1963. He called Hayek’s 1960 book
“the greatest exposition” of the principle of the need to limit democracy.

In that book Hayek sketched the potential excesses of democracy, drawing on both history and the present for his argument. He invoked recent Central European history first, saying that having “seen millions voting themselves into complete dependence on a tyrant has made our generation understand that to choose one’s government is not necessarily to secure freedom.”

He followed with a subtle dig against postcolonial governments, saying that “though the concept of national freedom is analogous to that of individual freedom, it is not the same; and the striving for the first has not always enhanced the second.” He observed that decolonization and democratic self-determination could have adverse outcomes: “It has sometimes led people to prefer a despot of their own race to the liberal government of an alien majority.”

zh: 哈耶克在南非期间就《自由秩序原理》作了演讲。哈特以《多种族社会中议会多数的滥用》（The Abuse of Parliamentary Majority in Multi-Racial Society）为题记下了这次访问，该文稿是关于哈耶克此番言论的唯一记录。
按照哈特的转述，哈耶克“对以黑人为主导的选民群体未来可能构成的威胁毫不抱幻想，但我们并不总是提醒自己：我们真正恐惧的，其实是国家权力”。
哈耶克认为，“正是白人……教会了非洲人：国家这台机器可以被用来谋取特定群体利益，主要体现为白人特权”。他问道：“既然如此，非洲领导人动不动就想着主客易位，又有什么奇怪呢？”
哈耶克传递给哈特等人的信息是：若事先剥夺国家准许特定群体规避竞争约束的权力，即使黑人选民日后掌握国家政权，在哈耶克看来也不会构成问题。与他1930年代的新自由主义联邦构想一样，哈耶克的方案是压低代议政府的分量，把它的职能缩减为维护竞争和执行契约。
en: Hayek lectured on his book
during his time in South Africa. Hutt wrote up the visit under the title “The Abuse of Parliamentary Majority in Multi-Racial Society,” which offers the only record of Hayek’s statements.

According to Hutt’s account, Hayek was “under no illusions about the threat which a Black-dominated electorate could constitute in the future but we do not always remind ourselves that it is the power of the state which we are really dreading.”

Hayek argued that “it is the Whites … who have taught the Africans that the machinery of the State may be used to secure sectional benefits—chiefly in the form of privileges for the Whites.” “Is it surprising then,” he asked, “that African leaders tend, all too easily to think in terms of turning the tables?”

Hayek’s message to Hutt and others was that a state captured by black voters would cease to be a problem if the state itself was stripped preemptively of its right to grant exemptions from the discipline of the competitive market. As with his idea of neoliberal federation from the 1930s, Hayek’s proposal was to downgrade the significance of representative government by reducing its roles to the enforcement of competition and contract.

zh: 哈特把他的加权选举权方案带进了美国新右派的刊物。1966年，他在《新个人评论》（
）上论证：在南非，“以‘一人一票’为基础最终扩大选举权后非洲人占多数的前景，引起了白人完全有理由的恐惧”。
他提出，唯一的解决办法是“放弃普选原则……接受某种形式的加权选举权”。
与勒普克一样，令哈特格外愤怒并付诸行动的，是他所看到的白人执政的罗得西亚在1965年发表《单方面独立宣言》、脱离英联邦之后所遭受的不公待遇。从1964年起，哈特开始致信罗得西亚总理伊恩·史密斯，进言如何确保“现政权虽有种种公认的毛病，却不至于被一个黑人统治的时代所取代”。
他建议以宪法保护财产，并再次建议实行“加权选举权安排”。
在一篇论“罗得西亚的冤案”（the Rhodesian calumny）的文章中，哈特为那些旨在维护白人少数统治的财产权限制辩护，视之为抵御“‘一人一票’暴政”的堡垒，并称罗得西亚是“世界所见过的最有希望的、自觉建设多种族完全民主社会的尝试”。
这听起来或许自相矛盾，但哈特主张：恰恰是否定普选权，才能成就真正的民主。
en: Hutt carried his proposals for weighted franchise into the publications of the U.S. New Right. In 1966 he argued in the

that in South Africa, “the prospect of an African majority, through the ultimate extension of the franchise on the basis of ‘one man, one vote’ created wholly justifiable fears on the part of the Whites.”
He suggested that the only solution was to “renounce the principle of universal suffrage … and accept some form of weighted franchise.”

Like Röpke, Hutt was especially enraged and mobilized by what he saw as the unjust treatment of the white-ruled country of Rhodesia after its Unilateral Declaration of Independence and departure from the British Commonwealth in 1965. Beginning in 1964 Hutt began sending letters to Prime Minister Ian Smith of Rhodesia with his advice about how to ensure that “the present regime, with all its admitted faults, shall not be replaced by an era of black domination.”
He suggested constitutional protections of property and, again, “weighted franchise arrangements.”

In an article on “the Rhodesian calumny,” Hutt defended the property restrictions designed to protect white-minority rule as a bulwark against “ ‘one man, one vote’ tyranny,” calling Rhodesia “the most promising deliberate attempt the world has ever seen at creating a wholly democratic, multi-racial society.”
As paradoxical as it might sound, Hutt argued that it was precisely by denying universal suffrage that true democracy could be realized.

zh: 整个1970与1980年代，哈特针对国际社会讨伐罗得西亚与南非之不公，持续发出抗议的鼓点。他致信罗纳德·里根州长与吉米·卡特总统，称赞罗得西亚是“非洲唯一真正反种族主义的民主国家”。
葡萄牙撤出安哥拉和莫桑比克殖民地之后，美国对南部非洲的立场趋于强硬：卡特于1977年重新禁止进口罗得西亚铬矿，其时人权话语兴起，要求向多数统治过渡的呼声高涨。
哈特敏感于政治模型以种族为据的正当性在持续流失，便向南非政治领袖提出其种族加权选举权模式的一项变通：改按收入给选票加权。1978年，他致信南非财政部长欧文·霍伍德，建议“如果按每个人所须缴纳的税额为其选票加权”，南非便可“理直气壮地宣称：随着肤色壁垒的瓦解，黑人、有色人、印度裔与白人将享有最完全的平等”。
哈特声称，这一措施足以安抚相当多的美国批评者，因为它等同于“一切种族的绝对平等”。
以收入为基的选票，将构成完全的政治无歧视，并向市场更高的智慧低头。
en: Through the 1970s and 1980s Hutt kept up a drumbeat of protest against the supposed injustice of the international mobilization against Rhodesia and South Africa. He wrote letters to Governor Ronald Reagan and President Jimmy Carter praising Rhodesia as “the only genuine anti-racist democracy in Africa.”

After Portugal withdrew from their colonies of Angola and Mozambique, the United States hardened its position against Southern Africa, with Carter reintroducing a ban on the import of Rhodesian chrome in 1977 amid new talk of human rights and demands for moves to majority rule.

Sensitive to the continuing shift away from political models based on race, Hutt proposed to political leaders in South Africa an innovation of his racially weighted franchise model. He suggested instead a weighting of the franchise according to income. In a letter to South African finance minister Owen Horwood in 1978, he suggested that “[if you] weight each person’s vote by the amount of taxes he is called upon to pay,” South Africa could “rightly insist that Blacks, Coloureds, Indians and Whites would have the most complete equality through the dissolution of the colour bars.”
Hutt claimed that this measure would appease enough American critics because it would amount to “absolute equality for all races.”
The vote based on income would amount to total political nondiscrimination and yield to the greater wisdom of the market.

zh: 哈特辩称，他的方案将实现他在1930年代首创的一个观念：“消费者主权”（consumer's sovereignty）。哈特论证，如果如米塞斯所乐道的“每一美元都是一张选票”，那么收入加权选举权将把这一类比推而广之——把一个人的财富换算为他选举代议政府时所拥有的相对权力。他辩称，如此革命性改革的效果，“在于强调公民实际上是在购买政府的服务，并使政府人员被视为公仆而不是统治者”。
哈特的方案并不像听上去那么新奇。除了明显回响着19世纪以财产限制选举权的旧调，值得注意的是，这种加权代表制模式已经为世界银行和国际货币基金组织所采用——两者都按各国参与全球贸易的份额决定投票权。哈特对民主的经济主义改造，实际上是把布雷顿森林机构缩放到公民层面的产物。他反对工作场所中的种族隔离，却主张以一个新的、等级化的经济选举特权序列来取代它。
en: Hutt argued that his proposal would achieve the realization of a notion he had coined in the 1930s: “consumer’s sovereignty.” Hutt argued that if “every dollar was a ballot,” in the phrase favored by Mises, income-weighted franchise would extend the analogy by translating one’s wealth into the relative power one had in electing a representative government. “The effect of so revolutionary a reform,” he argued, would be “to emphasize that citizens actually purchase the services of government and cause them to be regarded as public servants rather than as rulers.”

Hutt’s proposal was not as novel as it sounded. Beyond its obvious echoes of nineteenth-century property bars to the franchise, it is notable that such a model of weighted representation was already used at the World Bank and the IMF, both of which determined votes based on national participation in global trade. Hutt’s economistic adaptation of democracy actually scaled the Bretton Woods institutions down to the level of a citizenry. He opposed apartheid in the workplace, but he advocated a new economic hierarchy of electoral privilege to replace it.

zh: 哈特对南部非洲实行普选权的反对，得到新自由主义阵营中一些人的附和。
1970年，申菲尔德援引“极权民主的可怕危险”论证：“在南非的形势下限制选举权，不仅没有错；为了所有种族的利益，确实应当这样做。在南非，‘一人一票’意味着所有种族的灾难。”
类似的情绪也出自曾任《财富》（
）与《巴伦周刊》（Barron’s）记者的约翰·A.·达文波特，以及米尔顿·弗里德曼。两人都出席过MPS的成立大会，都是新自由主义知识运动的活跃成员。
与哈特一样，达文波特在1960与1970年代于八次MPS会议上发言；弗里德曼则凭借通俗写作与1976年荣获的诺贝尔经济学纪念奖而享誉国际。哈特声称，这两人到1970年代访问该地区之前，都与南部非洲并无瓜葛。
在那个十年，两人都成为该地区普选权直言不讳的批评者，而矛头尤指罗得西亚。
en: Hutt’s opposition to universal suffrage in Southern Africa was shared by some others in the neoliberal camp.

In 1970 Shenfield invoked “the hideous dangers of totalitarian democracy” as he argued that “the limitation of the franchise in South African circumstances is not only not wrong; it is positively desirable in the interests of all races.” “In South Africa,” he wrote, “ ‘one man one vote’ would mean disaster for all.
Similar sentiments came from journalist John A. Davenport, formerly of
and
and Milton Friedman. Both men had been at the founding meeting of the MPS and were active members in the neoliberal intellectual movement.

Like Hutt, Davenport spoke at eight MPS meetings, during the 1960s and 1970s, and Friedman had achieved international fame through his popular writing as well as the Nobel Memorial Prize he won in 1976. Hutt claimed that neither man had been engaged with Southern Africa until visiting the region in the 1970s.
In that decade, both became outspoken critics of universal suffrage for the region, with a focus on Rhodesia in particular.

zh: 达文波特对南部非洲白人统治的拥护程度，甚至超过了勒普克。还在1972年，南非新闻局就已就其公开支持政权的言行向达文波特致谢，包括他致《纽约时报》的信：该信为南非统治纳米比亚辩护，要求联合国不得“吞并”该国，不得使其遭受所谓“一人一票”民主的“屈辱”。
卡特政府1977年 明确转而反对罗得西亚史密斯政权后，达文波特与罗得西亚新闻局合作，在美国商人中间征集声援史密斯政府的签名。
达文波特两度赴罗得西亚，并以美国—罗得西亚协会（ARA）联合主席的身份，于1978年10月接待了受邀访美的史密斯——邀请者包括种族隔离主义者参议员杰西·赫尔姆斯和包括后来的总统候选人鲍勃·多尔在内的一群保守派参议员。
ARA在其宗旨声明中称制裁是“对野蛮行径的帮助与鼓励”，并致敬“罗得西亚（津巴布韦）作为自由世界在非洲外围堡垒的至高英勇与价值”。
进入1980年代、大学校园撤资运动兴起之际，达文波特仍不断谴责那场由“多数统治的狂热”和对“教条式民主的愚蠢”的笃信驱动的“对南非的不道德的侵略战争”。
1985年，他径直向白宫投诉制裁，得到总统助理帕特·布坎南的书面支持。
达文波特对南部非洲多数统治反对派并非被动同情，而是其在1970年代末与1980年代的头号积极分子之一。与哈特一样，他的论说双管齐下：既反制裁，也反普选。在这两点上与他并肩的是弗里德曼——战后新自由主义知识分子中最声名赫赫的一位；而在反对制裁一点上，哈耶克本人也加入其中。
en: Davenport’s advocacy for white rule in Southern Africa exceeded even that of Röpke. Already in 1972 the South African Information Service had commended Davenport on his public support for the regime, including his letter to the
defending South African rule in Namibia and demanding that the country not be “gobble[d] up by the UN” and “subjected to the indignities of so-called ‘one man, one vote’ democracy.”

After the Carter administration turned definitively against the Smith regime in Rhodesia in 1977, Davenport worked with the Rhodesian Information Service to gather signatures of support from American businessman for the Smith government.

Davenport took two trips to Rhodesia and, as the co-chairman of the American-Rhodesian Association (ARA), hosted Smith when he visited the States in October 1978 at the invitation of segregationist senator Jesse Helms and a group of other conservative senators, including later presidential candidate Bob Dole.

In its mission statement, the ARA called sanctions “an aid and encouragement to barbarism” and paid homage to the “supreme gallantry and value of Rhodesia (Zimbabwe) as an outer bastion of the Free World in Africa.”

Into the 1980s and the rise of the divestment movement on university campuses, Davenport continued to condemn the “immoral war of aggression on South Africa” driven by the “mania of majority rule” and a devotion to “the follies of doctrinaire democracy.”
In 1985 he complained directly to the White House about sanctions and received written support from the assistant to the president, Pat Buchanan.

Davenport was not passively sympathetic to the opposition to majority rule in Southern Africa but instead was one of its foremost activists in the late 1970s and 1980s. Like Hutt’s, his argument thrust in two directions: against sanctions and against universal suffrage. On these two points he was joined by Friedman, the most high-profile of postwar neoliberal intellectuals, and on the opposition to sanctions, by Hayek himself.

children: FRIEDMAN AND HAYEK’S MILITANT GLOBALISM AGAINST SANCTIONS

zh: 米尔顿·弗里德曼在《新闻周刊》（Newsweek）的两篇专栏中谴责对罗得西亚的制裁，其中一篇先刊发于伦敦《星期日泰晤士报》。
在1976年他亲赴该地区之后发表的那一栏里，他提出了一个初看令人错愕的论点：“今日罗得西亚的‘多数统治’，是黑人少数政府的婉语——它几乎肯定既意味着多数白人被驱逐或出走，也意味着广大罗得西亚黑人生活水平大幅下降、机会大幅减少。”
把普选权说成“少数统治”，表达的是弗里德曼对美国本土民主实践的怀疑。1976年，他在南非开普敦大学演讲时声称，一人一票的实践其实是“一套高度加权的投票制度，特殊利益在其中扮演的角色远比公共利益大得多”。
弗里德曼暗中取径曼瑟·奥尔森这样的理论家，论证“政治市场”青睐那些既有意愿又有资源组织起来的人，而不利于公众和弱势者的利益。
与之相对，经济市场则是“一套有效的比例代表制”。
针对南非情境，他提出了新奇的解决方案。人们抱怨白人免费上学而黑人学生须缴学费。他的办法是：让两边都缴。“就结果平等而言，”他提醒听众，“我并不赞成平等主义。”
不平等是运转中的市场秩序不可根除的条件。
en: Milton Friedman condemned sanctions against Rhodesia in two editorials for
one of which appeared first in the London

In the 1976 column, published after he traveled to the region, he made the initially perplexing argument that “ ‘Majority rule’ for Rhodesia today is a euphemism for a black-minority government, which would almost surely mean both the eviction or exodus of most of the whites and also a drastically lower level of living and opportunity for the masses of black Rhodesians.”

In defining universal suffrage as “minority rule,” Friedman expressed his skepticism about the practice of democracy in the United States itself. As he argued at the University of Cape Town in South Africa in 1976, the practice of one-man-one-vote was in fact “a system of highly-weighted voting in which special interests have far greater roles to play than does the general interest.”

Drawing implicitly on the work of theorists like Mancur Olson, Friedman argued that the “political market” favored those with the incentive and the resources to organize and militated against the interest of the public and the less powerful.
The economic market, by contrast, was “a system of effective, proportional representation.”

He proposed novel solutions for the South African context. People complained that whites received free education while black students had to pay. His solution: make them both pay. “I am not in favor of egalitarianism” he reminded his audience, “in the sense of equal results.”
Inequality was the ineradicable condition of a functioning market order.

zh: 弗里德曼循着勒普克的先例援引过詹姆斯·伯纳姆的话，称罗得西亚遭孤立是“西方自杀”的征候；但他的结论并非基于种族或文明水准，而是基于对选举民主实践的一般性批判。
他反对制裁还基于一条抽象原则：市场之成功，在于“它们联结生产者与消费者的精微巧妙，在于它们赋予参与者的匿名性”。既然理想的市场不因种族、宗教或国籍而歧视，那么由一个国际权威出面干预交换过程、以惩罚这个或那个政权——如对罗得西亚所为——便等于削弱“自由市场体系，而它正是我们最大的力量之源”。
所有权领域（dominium）必须超然于外交的反复无常之外。
en: Although Friedman followed Röpke by quoting James Burnham in saying that the isolation of Rhodesia was a sign of “the suicide of the West,” his conclusions were based not on race or level of civilization but on a general critique of the practice of electoral democracy.

His opposition to sanctions was also based on an abstract principle: that markets succeed through “the subtlety with which they connect producers and consumers and the anonymity in which they clothe the participants.” Because the ideal market does not discriminate by race, religion, or nationality, to interfere in processes of exchange to punish this or that political power through an international authority—as in the case of Rhodesia—would be to weaken “the system of free markets that is our greatest source of strength.”
Dominium had to exist beyond the whims of diplomacy.

zh: 哈耶克就南非发表的公开声明与弗里德曼相呼应。1970年代，他与弗里德曼访问皮诺切特治下的智利招致广泛批评，哈耶克1977年抱怨针对该南美国家的“国际上的名誉诋毁”，并说同样的矛头也指向南非——次年他将第二次访问这个国家。

他虽然强烈谴责种族隔离，却也表达了担忧：联合国点选特定国家予以惩罚的“恣意措施”，已成为自由世界经济最大的威胁之一。“联合国要想维护其影响力，只有一条路，”他写道，“那就是对个别国家采取抵制或其他类似措施时，依据既定而公示的规则行事，而不为争取选票而在个案中采取行动。”哈耶克警告说，此举将带来具有全球腐蚀性的严重恶果：“我不知道，同意对南非实施武器禁运的西方大国代表们，是否意识到他们因这一决定招致了怎样的危险。他们已经开始摧毁国际经济秩序。”
把制裁当作经济武器使用，逾越了划分财产世界与国家世界的边界。道德要求，哪怕经过国际组织合法化，也无权扰乱世界的经济宪法。
en: Hayek’s public statement on South Africa echoed Friedman’s. Amid widespread criticism of the visits he and Friedman paid to Pinochet’s Chile in the 1970s, Hayek complained in 1977 of the “international character assassination” aimed not just at the South American nation but at South Africa too, a country he would visit for the second time the following year.

While condemning apartheid in strong terms, he expressed fear that the “arbitrary measures” of the UN in singling out certain nations for punishment had become one of the greatest threats to the liberal world economy. “The U.N. can only protect its influence,” he wrote, “when boycotts or similar matters against individual countries are instituted according to set and posted rules, not when it lets itself be seduced through vote-catching in individual cases.” Hayek warned of drastic repercussions with globally corrosive effects: “l do not know whether the representatives of the Western Great Powers that have agreed to the arms embargo against South Africa realize the danger they are courting with this decision. They have begun to destroy the international economic order.”

The use of sanctions as an economic weapon transgressed the borders separating the world of property and the world of states. Moral demands, even those legitimized through international organizations, had no mandate to disrupt the economic constitution of the world.

zh: 南部非洲是一块试金石，从中可以看出新自由主义诸流派在非殖民化时代种族、世界秩序与帝国问题上的分歧。新自由主义阵营不但不存在单一立场，主要人物自身的立场也随时间而变。勒普克的急转或许最为极端。1930年代中期，他作为出于原则抵抗种族主义政权而流亡伊斯坦布尔的学者，曾以最鲜明的措辞谴责帝国主义。他说，欧洲海外扩张史“是一部征服、野蛮与暴行之史”。
他主张一种自由主义的反帝国主义，所反对的并非资本主义——一种积极守护他所称的“统治权（imperium）与所有权（dominium）——国家领域与经济领域”之分隔的立场。
三十年后，当非殖民化已成全球现实，他的调子变了。他此时宣称，殖民主义把西方文明带到了非西方世界，体现了“历史的狡计”（cunning of history）。1934年他还写道欧洲帝国主义对应着“民族内在生命中的全部非理性力量”，到1965年他却声称，威胁欧洲遗产的，是与之对抗的“巨大的混乱与破坏之力”。
最重要的是他新获得的信念：“欧洲化”已把整个地球变成“西方的单一殖民地”。
在他看来，既然如此，全球南方唯有放弃对西方化的排斥、将其奉为气质、生活方式与心态，才能获得稳定与相对繁荣。基因差异是否使这一点注定落空，他把这个问题悬而未答。清楚的是，勒普克的历史叙事不再是公共权威与私有财产的平衡之道，而转向主张西方精神（Geist）最终取得胜利。帝国不是一个已经终结的时代，而是一项有待完成的任务。
en: Southern Africa offers a litmus test for the varying neoliberal perspectives on the questions of race, world order, and empire in the age of decolonization. Not only was there no single position in the neoliberal camp, but the major players changed their positions over time. Röpke’s swerve was perhaps the most extreme. Writing from Istanbul in the mid-1930s as a scholar in exile out of principled resistance to a racist regime, he had condemned imperialism in stark terms. The history of overseas European expansion, he said, was “a history of conquest, barbarism and brutality.”

He argued for an anti-imperialism that was not anticapitalist but liberal—one that would actively safeguard the division, as he put it, between “imperium and dominium—the economic sphere and sphere of states.”

Three decades later, when decolonization had become a global reality, his refrain changed. Colonialism, he now claimed, had borne the “cunning of history” by bringing Western civilization to the non-Western world. Whereas he wrote in 1934 that European imperialism corresponded “to all of the irrational powers in the inner life of nations,” by 1965 he was claiming that it was European patrimony that was threatened by “the monstrous forces of chaos and destruction” that opposed it.
Most important was his newfound conviction that “Europeanization” had turned the whole earth into a “single colony of the West.”

Given this reality, stability and relative prosperity would come to the Global South only when they dropped their disavowal of Westernization and embraced it as an ethos, life way, and mindset. Whether genetic difference rendered this impossible was a question he left open. What was clear was that Röpke’s narrative of history was no longer one of balancing public authority and private property but had instead become one of prescribing the final victory of the Western
Empire was not an era that had ended but a task to be completed.

zh: 对哈特、弗里德曼与哈耶克而言，着眼点不是文明，而是能够促成有效市场秩序再生产的政治体制。他们首要的担忧是：要求普选或运用禁运、制裁等经济武器的那种错置的道德，可能掀翻可预期性与非人格性——而无数劳动者、销售者与消费者之间的协调，正系于二者。在传统内建的、不成文乃至不自觉的行为规范的公认约束之下，他们依然相信，多层级宪政设计有助于在世界各地保护财产和竞争。第六章与第七章将会显示，新自由主义的主流所见是一个规则的世界，而非种族的世界。而这个世界开始的地方，是欧洲。
en: For Hutt, Friedman, and Hayek, the focus was not civilizations but political systems that would encourage the reproduction of a working market order. Their chief concern was that misguided morality in the demands for universal suffrage or the wielding of economic weapons such as embargoes and sanctions might upend both predictability and the facelessness on which the coordination of countless laborers, sellers, and consumers depended. Within the recognized constraints of the unwritten and even unconscious codes of conduct built into tradition, they kept a basic faith in the utility of multilevel constitutional design as a means of safeguarding property and competition worldwide. As Chapters 6 and 7 will show, the main stream of neoliberals saw a world of rules, not a world of races. And the place where this world started was in Europe.
